	    (CASE WHEN aa.ShippingState = 'FO' THEN a.Foreign_Postal_Code__c
       	      WHEN ShippingCountry = 'CH' AND COALESCE( a.City__c,aa.ShippingCity) =  'Prangins' THEN '1197'
	          ELSE CONCAT(COALESCE(a.Zip_Code__c,aa.ShippingPostalCode),
			             (CASE WHEN a.Zip_Code_4__c  IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '-' END),
			              COALESCE(a.Zip_Code_4__c, '' )) 
		END) ZipCode,
		(CASE WHEN ShippingCountry = 'CH' Then 'SWITZERLAND'Else a.Country_Picklist__c END) Country,
	   
	   
	  
       Order_Sub_Total__c,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Final_Price__c), 0)
          FROM [dr].[PuritanSalesforceOrderLine]
         WHERE Order__c = o.id
           AND Tax__c = 0) AS Exempt_Amount,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Final_Price__c), 0)
          FROM [dr].[PuritanSalesforceOrderLine]
         WHERE Order__c = o.id
           AND Tax__c > 0) AS Taxable_Amount,
       COALESCE(Calculated_Shipping__c, 0) AS Calculated_Shipping,
       COALESCE(o.Tax__c, 0) AS Order_Line_Tax_Total,
       COALESCE(Misc_Charge_Amount__c, 0) AS Retail_Delivery_Fee,
       COALESCE(Calculated_Discount__c, 0) AS Calculated_Discount,
       COALESCE(Calculated_Order_Total__c, 0) AS Calculated_Order_Total,
       COALESCE((SELECT SUM(Final_Price__c)
                   FROM [dr].[PuritanSalesforceOrderLine]
                  WHERE Order__c = o.id
                    AND Tax__c = 0), 0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(Final_Price__c)
                                                      FROM [dr].[PuritanSalesforceOrderLine]
                                                     WHERE Order__c = o.id
                                                       AND Tax__c > 0), 0) + COALESCE(Calculated_Shipping__c, 0) + COALESCE(Misc_Charge_Amount__c, 0) + COALESCE(Calculated_Discount__c, 0) AS Total_Rpt
  FROM [dr].[PuritanSalesforceOrders] o 
  INNER JOIN [dr].[PuritanSalesforceOrderLine] l
               ON l.Order__c = o.id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN [dr].[DimPuritanSalesforceAddress] a
               ON a.ID = o.Ship_To_Address__c
  LEFT OUTER JOIN [dr].[DimPuritanSalesforceAccount] aa

 WHERE 1 = 1

   AND l.Item_Status__c = 'SHIPPED'
   AND o.Shipedge_Submitted__c='True'),
 B AS(
  SELECT 
       '' [Sales_Channel]
      ,[Type__c] as [Customer_Record_Type]
      ,COALESCE([Salesforce_Order_Number__c],o.[Primary_Order_Number__c]) as [Order_Number]
      ,o.[Primary_Order_Number__c] as[Primary_Order_Number]	 
      ,a.[CreatedDate] as [Order_Date]
      , Min_Shipped_Date__c as [Shipping_Confirmation]
      ,''[Ship_To_Address]
      ,''[City]
      ,''[State]
	  ,''Providence
      ,''[ZipCode]
	  ,''Country
      ,0 [Order_Sub_Total__c]
      ,0 [Exempt_Amount]
      ,0 [Taxable_Amount]
      ,0 [Calculated_Shipping]
      ,0 [Order_Line_Tax_Total]
      ,0 [Retail_Delivery_Fee]
      ,0 [Calculated_Discount]
      ,((Refund_or_Misc_Amount__c - Refund_or_Misc_Amount__c) -Refund_or_Misc_Amount__c) as[Calculated_Order_Total]
      ,0 [Total_Rpt]
  FROM [dr].[PuritanSalesforceOrderAdjustment] a
  INNER JOIN  [dr].[PuritanSalesforceOrders] o
  on a.Related_Order__c = o.id
  AND o.Order_Status__c = 'Shipped/Complete'

  where ((Refund_or_Misc_Amount__c - Refund_or_Misc_Amount__c) -Refund_or_Misc_Amount__c) IS NOT NULL
  ),
  C AS(
  SELECT * FROM A
  UNION
  SELECT * FROM B 
  )

  ,current_timestamp LastUpdate
  FROM C;

source.query:
WITH
sectmstp AS (SELECT MIN(SMHLFG) SMHLFG,
                    SMSECT
               FROM rsmfg.SECTMSTP
              GROUP BY SMSECT
              UNION ALL
             SELECT MIN(SMHLFG) SMHLFG,
                    SMSECT
               FROM prodfa.SECTMSTP
              GROUP BY SMSECT
              UNION ALL
             SELECT MIN(SMHLFG) SMHLFG,
                    SMSECT
               FROM slmfg.SECTMSTP
              GROUP BY SMSECT
              UNION ALL
             SELECT MIN(SMHLFG) SMHLFG,
                    SMSECT
               FROM camfg.SECTMSTP
              GROUP BY SMSECT),
BulkAndCompLocs AS (SELECT *
                      FROM prodfa.BLKLOCP
                     UNION ALL
                    SELECT *
                      FROM rsmfg.BLKLOCP
                     UNION ALL
                    SELECT *
                      FROM slmfg.BLKLOCP
                     UNION ALL
                    SELECT *
                      FROM camfg.BLKLOCP),
rawlocs AS (SELECT *
              FROM STARLEN.RWMTLCP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM softgels.RWMTLCP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM rsmfg.RWMTLCP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM slmfg.RWMTLCP
             UNION ALL
            SELECT *
              FROM camfg.RWMTLCP),
fginv AS (SELECT DIGITS(wrehs3) || '-' || DIGITS(rowloc) || '-' || skdloc || '-' || DIGITS(colloc) LOC,
                 WREHS3 WHS,
                 'FGINV' AREA,
                 lmsect SEC,
                 lmavl DEACT,
                 SMHLFG FLAG,
                 (CASE
                       WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 45 THEN (CASE
                                                           WHEN LOC1 > 1200 THEN 'Narrow'
                                                           ELSE 'Wide'
                                                      END)
                       WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 44 THEN (CASE
                                                           WHEN LOC1 BETWEEN 174 AND 188 THEN 'Wide'
                                                           ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                      END)
                       WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 46 THEN (CASE
                                                           WHEN LOC1 BETWEEN 140 AND 180 THEN 'Wide'
                                                           ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                      END)
                       ELSE 'Not Setup ' || DIGITS(wrehs3)
                  END) LOC2,
                 (CASE
                       WHEN wrehs3 IN (3, 14, 22, 48) THEN 'NBTYMFG'
                       WHEN wrehs3 IN (44, 45, 46, 47) THEN 'REXALL'
                       WHEN wrehs3 IN (62, 63) THEN 'LEINER'
                       ELSE 'SOLGAR'
                  END) DCGROUP
            FROM prodfa.invlocp i
           INNER JOIN prodfa.locmst
                   ON wrehs3 = fgwhse
                  AND loc1 = rowloc
                  AND loc2 = skdloc
                  AND loc3 = colloc
           INNER JOIN sectmstp
                   ON SMSECT = LMSECT
           WHERE WREHS3 =47
             AND skdloc BETWEEN '01' AND '99'
             AND SUBSTR(lmsect, 1, 1) <> '#'
           GROUP BY DIGITS(wrehs3) || '-' || DIGITS(rowloc) || '-' || skdloc || '-' || DIGITS(colloc),
                    WREHS3,
                    lmsect,
                    lmavl,
                    SMHLFG,
                    (CASE
                          WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 45 THEN (CASE
                                                              WHEN LOC1 > 1200 THEN 'Narrow'
                                                              ELSE 'Wide'
                                                         END)
                          WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 44 THEN (CASE
                                                              WHEN LOC1 BETWEEN 174 AND 188 THEN 'Wide'
                                                              ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                         END)
                          WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 46 THEN (CASE
                                                              WHEN LOC1 BETWEEN 140 AND 180 THEN 'Wide'
                                                              ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                         END)
                          ELSE 'Not Setup ' || DIGITS(wrehs3)
                     END)),
cpinv AS (SELECT DIGITS(blwhse) || '-' || DIGITS(c.rowloc) || '-' || c.skdloc || '-' || DIGITS(c.colloc) LOC,
                 WREHS3 WHS,
                 (CASE
                       WHEN PART#P IN (11, 31, 32, 33) THEN 'BULK'
                       ELSE 'COMP'
                  END) AREA,
                 lmsect SEC,
                 lmavl DEACT,
                 SMHLFG Flag,
                 (CASE
                       WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 45 THEN (CASE
                                                           WHEN l.ROWLOC > 1200 THEN 'Narrow'
                                                           ELSE 'Wide'
                                                      END)
                       WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 44 THEN (CASE
                                                           WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 174 AND 188 THEN 'Wide'
                                                           ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                      END)
                       WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 46 THEN (CASE
                                                           WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 140 AND 180 THEN 'Wide'
                                                           ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                      END)
                       ELSE 'Not Setup ' || DIGITS(wrehs3)
                  END) LOC2,
                 (CASE
                       WHEN wrehs3 IN (3, 14, 22, 48) THEN 'NBTYMFG'
                       WHEN wrehs3 IN (44, 45, 46, 47) THEN 'REXALL'
                       WHEN wrehs3 IN (62, 63) THEN 'LEINER'
                       ELSE 'SOLGAR'
                  END) DCGROUP
            FROM BulkAndCompLocs c
           INNER JOIN prodfa.locmst l
                   ON wrehs3 = blwhse
                  AND l.rowloc = c.rowloc
                  AND l.skdloc = c.skdloc
                  AND l.colloc = c.colloc
           INNER JOIN sectmstp
                   ON SMSECT = l.LMSECT
           WHERE WREHS3 = 47
             AND l.skdloc BETWEEN '01' AND '99'
             AND SUBSTR(l.lmsect, 1, 1) <> '#'
             AND l.LMSECT <> ''
           GROUP BY DIGITS(blwhse) || '-' || DIGITS(c.rowloc) || '-' || c.skdloc || '-' || DIGITS(c.colloc),
                    WREHS3,
                    (CASE
                          WHEN PART#P IN (11, 31, 32, 33) THEN 'BULK'
                          ELSE 'COMP'
                     END),
                    lmsect,
                    lmavl,
                    SMHLFG,
                    (CASE
                          WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 45 THEN (CASE
                                                              WHEN l.ROWLOC > 1200 THEN 'Narrow'
                                                              ELSE 'Wide'
                                                         END)
                          WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 44 THEN (CASE
                                                              WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 174 AND 188 THEN 'Wide'
                                                              ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                         END)
                          WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 46 THEN (CASE
                                                              WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 140 AND 180 THEN 'Wide'
                                                              ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                         END)
                          ELSE 'Not Setup ' || DIGITS(wrehs3)
                     END)),
rawinv AS (SELECT DIGITS(rmwhse) || '-' || DIGITS(r.rmlrow) || '-' || r.rmlskd || '-' || DIGITS(r.rmlclm) LOC,
                  WREHS3 WHS,
                  'RAW' AREA,
                  lmsect SEC,
                  lmavl DEACT,
                  SMHLFG FLAG,
                  (CASE
                        WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 45 THEN (CASE
                                                            WHEN l.ROWLOC > 1200 THEN 'Narrow'
                                                            ELSE 'Wide'
                                                       END)
                        WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 44 THEN (CASE
                                                            WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 174 AND 188 THEN 'Wide'
                                                            ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                       END)
                        WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 46 THEN (CASE
                                                            WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 140 AND 180 THEN 'Wide'
                                                            ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                       END)
                        ELSE 'Not Setup ' || DIGITS(wrehs3)
                   END) LOC2,
                  (CASE
                        WHEN wrehs3 IN (3, 14, 22, 48) THEN 'NBTYMFG'
                        WHEN wrehs3 IN (44, 45, 46, 47) THEN 'REXALL'
                        WHEN wrehs3 IN (62, 63) THEN 'LEINER'
                        ELSE 'SOLGAR'
                   END) DCGROUP
             FROM rawLocs r
            INNER JOIN prodfa.locmst l
                    ON wrehs3 = rmwhse
                   AND l.rowloc = r.rmlrow
                   AND l.skdloc = r.rmlskd
                   AND l.colloc = r.rmlclm
            INNER JOIN sectmstp
                    ON SMSECT = l.LMSECT
            WHERE WREHS3 = 47
              AND r.rmlskd BETWEEN '01' AND '99'
              AND SUBSTR(l.lmsect, 1, 1) <> '#'
              AND l.LMSECT <> ''
            GROUP BY DIGITS(rmwhse) || '-' || DIGITS(r.rmlrow) || '-' || r.rmlskd || '-' || DIGITS(r.rmlclm),
                     WREHS3,
                     lmsect,
                     lmavl,
                     SMHLFG,
                     (CASE
                           WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 45 THEN (CASE
                                                               WHEN l.ROWLOC > 1200 THEN 'Narrow'
                                                               ELSE 'Wide'
                                                          END)
                           WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 44 THEN (CASE
                                                               WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 174 AND 188 THEN 'Wide'
                                                               ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                          END)
                           WHEN DIGITS(wrehs3) = 46 THEN (CASE
                                                               WHEN l.ROWLOC BETWEEN 140 AND 180 THEN 'Wide'
                                                               ELSE 'Narrow'
                                                          END)
                           ELSE 'Not Setup ' || DIGITS(wrehs3)
                      END)),
Allinv AS (SELECT *
             FROM fginv
            UNION ALL
           SELECT *
             FROM cpinv
            UNION ALL
           SELECT *
             FROM rawinv),
DCTOTALS AS (SELECT WHS AS WHS,
                    DCGROUP AS Group,
                    COUNT(WHS) ALLDCTOTALUSED,
                    CASE
                         WHEN FLAG = 'H' THEN COUNT(WHS)
                         ELSE 0
                    END ALLDCUSEDLHI,
                    CASE

WITH

                     l.WREHS3 WHS,
                     'EMPTY' Area,

                        SUM(bdwt) WEIGHT,

                         END) TRANSMODE,

                              WHEN SUBSTR(BHPST, 1, 1) = 'F' THEN 'FTL'
                              WHEN SUBSTR(BHPST, 1, 1) = 'I' THEN 'IMC'

                              WHEN bhnonecnt <> '' THEN bhnonecnt

                                                 FROM nbjdta.artpltpf,
                                                      nbjdta.artordpf
                                                WHERE obolnum = bhbl#
                                                  AND oorddiv = porddiv
                                                  AND oordnum = pordnum
                                                  AND oordbos = pordbos) > 0 THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ppltid)
                                                                                     FROM nbjdta.artpltpf,
                                                                                          nbjdta.artordpf
                                                                                    WHERE obolnum = bhbl#
                                                                                      AND oorddiv = porddiv
                                                                                      AND oordnum = pordnum
                                                                                      AND oordbos = pordbos)
                                         ELSE COALESCE((SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(BDTXT, LOCATE('PALLETS:', BDTXT) + 9, 3))
                                                          FROM NBJDTA.BLDET
                                                         WHERE bdbl# = bhbl#
                                                           AND LOCATE('PALLETS:', bdtxt) > 0), (SELECT SUM(bdunt)
                                                                                                  FROM NBJDTA.BLDET
                                                                                                 WHERE bdbl# = bhbl#
                                                                                                   AND BDUOM = 'PLT'), 0)
                                    END)
                         END) PALLETS,
                        REPLACE(LTRIM(REPLACE(BHGTS#, '0', ' ')), ' ', '0') GTS#1,
                        REPLACE(LTRIM(REPLACE(BHGTS#1, '0', ' ')), ' ', '0') GTS#2,
                        REPLACE(LTRIM(REPLACE(BHGTS#2, '0', ' ')), ' ', '0') GTS#3,
                        REPLACE(LTRIM(REPLACE(BHGTS#3, '0', ' ')), ' ', '0') GTS#4,
                        REPLACE(LTRIM(REPLACE(BHGTS#4, '0', ' ')), ' ', '0') GTS#5,
                        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT gtplt#)
                           FROM PRODFA.GT011P
                          WHERE GTSHP# IN ((CASE
                                                 WHEN BHGTS# = '' THEN 0
                                                 ELSE INT(BHGTS#)
                                            END), (CASE
                                                        WHEN BHGTS#1 = '' THEN 0
                                                        ELSE INT(BHGTS#1)
                                                   END), (CASE
                                                               WHEN BHGTS#2 = '' THEN 0
                                                               ELSE INT(BHGTS#2)
                                                          END), (CASE
                                                                      WHEN BHGTS#3 = '' THEN 0
                                                                      ELSE INT(BHGTS#3)
                                                                 END), (CASE
                                                                             WHEN BHGTS#4 = '' THEN 0
                                                                             ELSE INT(BHGTS#4)
                                                                        END))) SKIDTAGCNT,
                        COALESCE(MIN(OVRCARC), '') AWARDCARRIERCOD,
                        COALESCE((SELECT MIN(frdesc)
                                    FROM nbjdta.frtmst
                                   WHERE frnum = OVRCARC), '') AWARDCARRIERNAM,
                        COALESCE(MIN(OVRRCODE), '') OVRREASONCODE,
                        COALESCE((SELECT BLRSDS
                                    FROM NBJDTA.BLREASONPF
                                   WHERE BLRSCD = OVRRCODE), '') REASONDESC,
                        (CASE
                              WHEN (SELECT BOLNUMBER
                                      FROM NBJDTA.ACSNOHITS
                                     WHERE BOLNUMBER = bhbl#
                                       AND LANETYPEID = (SELECT ID
                                                           FROM NBJDTA.ACSLANETYP
                                                          WHERE LANETYPE = '5d->5d')) IS NULL THEN 'Y'
                              ELSE 'N'
                         END) ZipToZipLane,
                        (CASE
                              WHEN (SELECT BOLNUMBER
                                      FROM NBJDTA.ACSNOHITS
                                     WHERE BOLNUMBER = bhbl#
                                       AND LANETYPEID = (SELECT ID
                                                           FROM NBJDTA.ACSLANETYP
                                                          WHERE LANETYPE = 'state->state')) IS NULL THEN 'Y'
                              ELSE 'N'
                         END) StToStLane,
                        COALESCE((SELECT MIN(acc.blfl1)
                                    FROM CALCRATE.BLRATEL acc
                                   WHERE acc.BLMST = bhbl#
                                     AND acc.BLPRO = bhpro), '') ACCRUALMETHOD,
                        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(acc.blrt1)
                                    FROM CALCRATE.BLRATEL acc
                                   WHERE acc.BLMST = bhbl#
                                     AND acc.BLPRO = bhpro), 0) ACCRUEDCOST,
                        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(acc.blnet)
                                    FROM CALCRATE.BLRATEL acc
                                   WHERE acc.BLMST = bhbl#
                                     AND acc.BLPRO = bhpro), 0) ACCRUEDNET,
                        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(acc.blac$)
                                    FROM CALCRATE.BLRATEL acc
                                   WHERE acc.BLMST = bhbl#
                                     AND acc.BLPRO = bhpro), 0) ACCRUEDACC,
                        COALESCE((SELECT SUM(acc.blsr$)
                                    FROM CALCRATE.BLRATEL acc
                                   WHERE acc.BLMST = bhbl#
                                     AND acc.BLPRO = bhpro), 0) ACCRUEDFUEL
                   FROM nbjdta.blhdr
                  INNER JOIN NBJDTA.BLDET
                          ON bhbl# = bdbl#
                   LEFT OUTER JOIN NBJDTA.OVRCARPF
                                ON OVRBL# = bhbl#
                               AND OVRRANK = 1
                  WHERE bhsdt >= INT(CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE - 7 DAYS) -1928 ,RIGHT('0' || RTRIM(MONTH(CURRENT_DATE -7 DAYS)), 2)),RIGHT('0' || RTRIM(DAY(CURRENT_DATE -7 DAYS)), 2))) 
                    AND bhsdt <= INT(CONCAT(CONCAT(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) -1928 ,RIGHT('0' || RTRIM(MONTH(CURRENT_DATE)), 2)),RIGHT('0' || RTRIM(DAY(CURRENT_DATE)), 2)))
                    AND bhcat = '01'
                    AND BHBL# NOT IN ('MB081514-003', 'MB081514-003', 'MB012115-007')
                  GROUP BY DIGITS(DEC(INT(SUBSTR(bhsdt, 1, 2) + 1928), 4, 0)) || '-' || SUBSTR(bhsdt, 3, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(bhsdt, 5, 2),
                           bhbl#,
                           bhcat,
                           bhpro,
                           bhcrr,
                           (SELECT frdesc
                              FROM nbjdta.frtmst
                             WHERE frnum = TRIM(bhcrr)),
                           bhwhs,
                           bhpcty,
                           bhpsta,
                           bhpzp5,
                           bhsnam,
                           bhscty,
                           bhsst,
                           DIGITS(bhszp5),
                           SUBSTR(bhpst, 1, 1),
                           (CASE
                                 WHEN (SELECT MIN(bdbl#)
                                         FROM nbjdta.bldet
                                        WHERE (LOCATE('TEMP', bdtxt) > 0 OR
                                               LOCATE('DEGREE', bdtxt) > 0 OR
                                               LOCATE('REEFER', bdtxt) > 0)
                                          AND bdbl# = bhbl#) IS NOT NULL OR
                                      SUBSTR(BHPST, 2, 1) = 'R' THEN 'Reefer'
                                 ELSE 'Dry'
                            END),
                           (CASE
                                 WHEN SUBSTR(BHPST, 1, 1) = 'L' THEN 'LTL'
                                 WHEN SUBSTR(BHPST, 1, 1) = 'F' THEN 'FTL'
                                 WHEN SUBSTR(BHPST, 1, 1) = 'I' THEN 'IMC'
                                 WHEN TRIM(BHCRR) IN ('PC', 'HU') THEN 'IMC'
                                 WHEN BHSEAL <> '' THEN 'FTL'
                                 ELSE 'LTL'
                            END),
                           (CASE
                                 WHEN bhnonecnt <> '' THEN bhnonecnt
                                 ELSE (CASE
                                            WHEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ppltid)
                                                    FROM nbjdta.artpltpf,
                                                         nbjdta.artordpf
                                                   WHERE obolnum = bhbl#
                                                     AND oorddiv = porddiv
                                                     AND oordnum = pordnum
                                                     AND oordbos = pordbos) > 0 THEN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ppltid)
                                                                                        FROM nbjdta.artpltpf,
                                                                                             nbjdta.artordpf
                                                                                       WHERE obolnum = bhbl#
                                                                                         AND oorddiv = porddiv
                                                                                         AND oordnum = pordnum
                                                                                         AND oordbos = pordbos)
                                            ELSE COALESCE((SELECT MAX(SUBSTR(BDTXT, LOCATE('PALLETS:', BDTXT) + 9, 3))
                                                             FROM NBJDTA.BLDET
                                                            WHERE bdbl# = bhbl#
                                                              AND LOCATE('PALLETS:', bdtxt) > 0), (SELECT SUM(bdunt)
                                                                                                     FROM NBJDTA.BLDET
                                                                                                    WHERE bdbl# = bhbl#
                                                                                                      AND BDUOM = 'PLT'), 0)
                                       END)
                            END),
                           BHGTS#,
                           BHGTS#1,
                           BHGTS#2,
                           BHGTS#3,
                           BHGTS#4,
                           (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT gtplt#)
                              FROM PRODFA.GT011P
                             WHERE GTSHP# IN ((CASE
                                                    WHEN BHGTS# = '' THEN 0
                                                    ELSE INT(BHGTS#)
                                               END), (CASE
                                                           WHEN BHGTS#1 = '' THEN 0
                                                           ELSE INT(BHGTS#1)
                                                      END), (CASE
                                                                  WHEN BHGTS#2 = '' THEN 0
                                                                  ELSE INT(BHGTS#2)
                                                             END), (CASE
                                                                         WHEN BHGTS#3 = '' THEN 0
                                                                         ELSE INT(BHGTS#3)
                                                                    END), (CASE
                                                                                WHEN BHGTS#4 = '' THEN 0
                                                                                ELSE INT(BHGTS#4)
                                                                           END))),
                           COALESCE((SELECT MIN(frdesc)
                                       FROM nbjdta.frtmst
                                      WHERE frnum = OVRCARC), ''),
                           COALESCE((SELECT BLRSDS
                                       FROM NBJDTA.BLREASONPF
                                      WHERE BLRSCD = OVRRCODE), ''),
                           (CASE
                                 WHEN (SELECT BOLNUMBER
                                         FROM NBJDTA.ACSNOHITS
                                        WHERE BOLNUMBER = bhbl#
                                          AND LANETYPEID = (SELECT ID
                                                              FROM NBJDTA.ACSLANETYP
                                                             WHERE LANETYPE = '5d->5d')) IS NULL THEN 'Y'
                                 ELSE 'N'
                            END),
                           (CASE
                                 WHEN (SELECT BOLNUMBER
                                         FROM NBJDTA.ACSNOHITS
                                        WHERE BOLNUMBER = bhbl#
                                          AND LANETYPEID = (SELECT ID
                                                              FROM NBJDTA.ACSLANETYP
                                                             WHERE LANETYPE = 'state->state')) IS NULL THEN 'Y'
                                 ELSE 'N'
                            END))

	  FROM [dr].[calendar]
	  JOIN [dr].[Shipping_Days] ON [Shipping_Days].[Date]=[calendar].[Date]

  FROM [dr].[calendar] C
	JOIN (SELECT [Date]
		  ,(SELECT MAX(S.[DATE]) FROM [dr].[calendar] S WHERE S.[Shipping_Day]='Y' AND S.[DATE]<O.[DATE]) prior_day
	  FROM [dr].[calendar] O
	  where [Shipping_Day] is not null AND [Prior_Shipping_Date] IS NULL
	) SUB
	  ON C.[DATE]=SUB.[DATE]

    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY LISTENTRY_REPORTER_COUNTRY --MANINI 
     ON PAGE_THREE.LIST36 = LISTENTRY_REPORTER_COUNTRY.ENTRYID 
          AND LISTENTRY_REPORTER_COUNTRY.PARENTID = 365 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY LISTENTRY_CONSUMER_COUNTRY --SMITHA 
     ON PAGE_THREE.LIST38 = LISTENTRY_CONSUMER_COUNTRY.ENTRYID 
          AND LISTENTRY_CONSUMER_COUNTRY.PARENTID = 365 
        LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_BRAND 
     ON PSR.ID = FLEX_BRAND.ID 
     AND FLEX_BRAND.ATTID = 2472640 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY LISTENTRY_BRAND 
     ON FLEX_BRAND.NUMBER1 = LISTENTRY_BRAND.ENTRYID 
  LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_SERIOUS_ADVERSE --Smitha 
     ON PSR.ID = FLEX_SERIOUS_ADVERSE.ID 
     AND FLEX_SERIOUS_ADVERSE.ATTID = 2472649 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY LISTENTRY_SERIOUS_ADVERSE 
     ON FLEX_SERIOUS_ADVERSE.NUMBER1 = LISTENTRY_SERIOUS_ADVERSE.ENTRYID 
     AND LISTENTRY_SERIOUS_ADVERSE.PARENTID = 2000003226 
  LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_INTERNATIONAL --Smitha 
     ON PSR.ID = FLEX_INTERNATIONAL.ID 
     AND FLEX_INTERNATIONAL.ATTID = 2472642 
        LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX INVESTIGATION_REQUESTED 
     ON PSR.ID = INVESTIGATION_REQUESTED.ID 
     AND INVESTIGATION_REQUESTED.ATTID = 2472648 
-- Updated Start 
LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_SALESFORCE_CREATE_USER 
ON PSR.ID = FLEX_SALESFORCE_CREATE_USER.ID 
AND FLEX_SALESFORCE_CREATE_USER.ATTID = 2472768 
LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_SALESFORCE_CREATE_DATE 
ON PSR.ID = FLEX_SALESFORCE_CREATE_DATE.ID 
AND FLEX_SALESFORCE_CREATE_DATE.ATTID = 2472769 
LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_SALESFORCE_LASTUPD_USER 
ON PSR.ID = FLEX_SALESFORCE_LASTUPD_USER.ID 
AND FLEX_SALESFORCE_LASTUPD_USER.ATTID = 2472770 
LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_SALESFORCE_LASTUPD_DATE 
ON PSR.ID = FLEX_SALESFORCE_LASTUPD_DATE.ID 
AND FLEX_SALESFORCE_LASTUPD_DATE.ATTID = 2472771 
--Updated End 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY LISTENTRY_INTERNATIONAL 
     ON FLEX_INTERNATIONAL.NUMBER1 = LISTENTRY_INTERNATIONAL.ENTRYID 
     AND LISTENTRY_INTERNATIONAL.PARENTID = 2000003226 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PSR_ITEM 
     ON PSR.ID = PSR_ITEM.PSR_ID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.ITEM 
     ON PSR_ITEM.ITEM_ID = ITEM.ID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PAGE_TWO 
     ON PSR_ITEM.ITEM_ID = PAGE_TWO.ID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.NODETABLE 
     ON ITEM.SUBCLASS = NODETABLE.ID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED 
     ON PSR.ID = FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED.ID 
     AND FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED.ATTID = 2472766 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_DESCRIPTION 
     ON PSR.ID = FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_DESCRIPTION.ID 
     AND FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_DESCRIPTION.ATTID = 2472767 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY LISTENTRY_MFG_SITE 
     ON PSR_ITEM.LIST01 = LISTENTRY_MFG_SITE.ENTRYID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY LISTENTRY_PKG_SITE 
     ON PSR_ITEM.LIST02 = LISTENTRY_PKG_SITE.ENTRYID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX AGILE_DATE 
     ON PSR.ID = AGILE_DATE.ID 
     AND AGILE_DATE.ATTID = 2472650 
 LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNAME 
 ON PSR.ID=FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNAME.ID 
 AND FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNAME.ATTID=2000009197  
     and psr_item.id=FLEX_UNIDENTIFIED_PRODUCTNAME.row_id--Chandana P 
        LEFT OUTER JOIN 
      ( 
      SELECT DISTINCT 
         PSR.ID COMPLAINT_ID 
         ,QCR.QCR_NUMBER CINV_NUMBER 
         ,AGILE_FLEX.TEXT EQUIPMENT_TRENDS 
       FROM 
         AGILE.PSR 
       INNER JOIN AGILE.RELATIONSHIP 
         ON PSR.ID = RELATIONSHIP.EFF_OBJID 
         AND PSR.PSR_NO LIKE 'CPC%' 
       INNER JOIN AGILE.QCR 
         ON RELATIONSHIP.CTR_OBJID = QCR.ID 
         AND QCR.QCR_NUMBER LIKE 'CINV%' 
       LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX 
         ON QCR.ID = AGILE_FLEX.ID 
         AND AGILE_FLEX.ATTID = 2472808 
      ) AUX_CINV 
                                         ON PSR.ID = AUX_CINV.COMPLAINT_ID 
          LEFT OUTER JOIN 
      ( 
       SELECT DISTINCT 
         PSR.ID COMPLAINT_ID 
         ,QCR.QCR_NUMBER AER_NUMBER 
                ,(select text33 from agile.page_three where page_three.id = qcr.id ) ASSESSMENT 
                --,(select text32 from agile.page_three where page_three.id = psr.id ) REPORTER_NAME 
       FROM 
         AGILE.PSR 
       INNER JOIN AGILE.RELATIONSHIP 
         ON PSR.ID = RELATIONSHIP.EFF_OBJID 
         AND PSR.PSR_NO LIKE 'CPC%' 
       INNER JOIN AGILE.QCR 
         ON RELATIONSHIP.CTR_OBJID = QCR.ID 
         AND QCR.QCR_NUMBER LIKE 'AER%' 
       LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.AGILE_FLEX 
         ON QCR.ID = AGILE_FLEX.ID 
         AND AGILE_FLEX.ATTID = '2472808' 
      ) AUX_AER 
     ON PSR.ID = AUX_AER.COMPLAINT_ID 
          AND AUX_AER.COMPLAINT_ID = AUX_CINV.COMPLAINT_ID 
           --Manini                      
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PAGE_THREE ITEM_PAGE_THREE 
     ON ITEM_PAGE_THREE.ID = ITEM.ID 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.LISTENTRY BULK_TYPE_LISTENTRY 
     ON BULK_TYPE_LISTENTRY.ENTRYID = ITEM_PAGE_THREE.LIST31 
    WHERE 
     PSR.PSR_NO LIKE 'CPC%'  
   ) AUX 
) AUX_DATES 
LEFT OUTER JOIN 
  ( 
   SELECT DISTINCT 
    AUX.COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
    ,AUX.ITEM_NUMBER 
    ,AUX.ITEM_TYPE 
    ,AUX.LOT_NUMBER 
    ,CASE 
        WHEN UPPER(AUX.ITEM_TYPE) = 'BULK' THEN 1 
        WHEN UPPER(AUX.ITEM_TYPE) = 'DISTRIBUTION UNIT' THEN 1 --Smitha - TSK200840 
    WHEN UPPER(AUX.ITEM_TYPE) = 'FINISHED GOODS' AND (INSTR(UPPER(AUX_COL), 'BULK')) > 0 THEN 2 --modified from Finished Goods  Smitha 
    WHEN UPPER(AUX.ITEM_TYPE) = 'FINISHED GOODS' AND (INSTR(UPPER(AUX_COL), 'BULK')) = 0 THEN 1 --modified from Finished Goods  Smitha 
        WHEN UPPER(AUX.ITEM_TYPE) = 'DISTRIBUTION UNIT' AND (INSTR(UPPER(AUX_COL), 'BULK')) > 0 THEN 2 --Smitha - TSK200840 
        WHEN UPPER(AUX.ITEM_TYPE) = 'DISTRIBUTION UNIT' AND (INSTR(UPPER(AUX_COL), 'BULK')) = 0 THEN 1 --Smitha - TSK200840 
    END LOT_COUNT 
   FROM 
    (  
     SELECT 
      PSR.PSR_NO COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
      ,ITEM.ITEM_NUMBER 
      ,PSR_ITEM.TEXT01 LOT_NUMBER 
      ,NODETABLE.DESCRIPTION ITEM_TYPE 
     FROM 
      AGILE.PSR 
     LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PSR_ITEM 
      ON PSR.ID = PSR_ITEM.PSR_ID 
     LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.ITEM 
      ON PSR_ITEM.ITEM_ID = ITEM.ID 
     LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.NODETABLE 
      ON ITEM.SUBCLASS = NODETABLE.ID 
     WHERE 
      PSR.PSR_NO LIKE 'CPC%' 
    ) AUX   
   INNER JOIN 
     ( 
      SELECT DISTINCT 
       PSR.PSR_NO COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
       ,PSR_ITEM.TEXT01 LOT_NUMBER 
       ,LISTAGG(NODETABLE.DESCRIPTION, ';') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY NODETABLE.DESCRIPTION) AS AUX_COL 
      FROM 
       AGILE.PSR 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PSR_ITEM 
       ON PSR.ID = PSR_ITEM.PSR_ID 
            LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.PSR_ITEM 
       ON PSR.ID = PSR_ITEM.PSR_ID 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.ITEM 
       ON PSR_ITEM.ITEM_ID = ITEM.ID 
      LEFT OUTER JOIN AGILE.NODETABLE 
       ON ITEM.SUBCLASS = NODETABLE.ID 
      WHERE 
       PSR.PSR_NO LIKE 'CPC%' 
      GROUP BY 
       PSR.PSR_NO 
       ,PSR_ITEM.TEXT01 
     ) AUX2 
    ON AUX.COMPLAINT_NUMBER = AUX2.COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
    AND AUX.LOT_NUMBER = AUX2.LOT_NUMBER 
  ) AUX_LOT_COUNT 
ON AUX_DATES.COMPLAINT_NUMBER = AUX_LOT_COUNT.COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
AND AUX_DATES.AFFECTED_ITEM_NUMBER = AUX_LOT_COUNT.ITEM_NUMBER 
AND AUX_DATES.LOT_NUMBER = AUX_LOT_COUNT.LOT_NUMBER 
WHERE 
AUX_DATES.AUX_ORIG_DATE = AUX_DATES.AUX_DATE 
ORDER BY 
AUX_DATES.ORIG_DATE 
,AUX_DATES.COMPLAINT_NUMBER 
,AUX_DATES.AFFECTED_ITEM_NUMBER 
,AUX_LOT_COUNT.LOT_COUNT

activities.name: IntegratedOrders_SCDType2
activities.description: This script will check all active records and will disable them if there is a newer record available. This way we can have history of how the records are changing over time but will only have the latest as active.

scripts.text:
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#F_Table_Dates') IS NOT NULL
DROP TABLE #F_Table_Dates 

select * 

into #F_Table_Dates

from (
		 select 
				 OrderHeaderSalesDocumentID
				,OrderLINeItemNumber
				,Start_Date
				,End_Date
				,lead(Start_Date,1) over (
											partition by OrderHeaderSalesDocumentID,OrderLINeItemNumber order by convert(date,Start_Date)) as next_start 

		FROM
				[dr].[IntegratedOrders_ext]

				) sub where next_start is not null AND End_Date <> dateadd(second,-1,next_start) AND convert(date,End_Date) = convert(date,'9999-12-31')


IF EXISTS (
	SELECT 1
	FROM #F_Table_Dates b 
)
			BEGIN
				
				UPDATE [dr].[IntegratedOrders_ext]
				set End_Date = dateadd(second,-1,b.next_start)
				from #F_Table_Dates b
				where	b.OrderHeaderSalesDocumentID = [IntegratedOrders_ext].OrderHeaderSalesDocumentID AND
						b.OrderLINeItemNumber =[IntegratedOrders_ext].OrderLINeItemNumber
						
					and [IntegratedOrders_ext].Start_Date = b.Start_Date
					and b.End_Date <> dateadd(second,-1,b.next_start)
					and convert(date,b.End_Date) = convert(date,'9999-12-31')
					AND CONVERT(DATE,[IntegratedOrders_ext].End_Date) = convert(date,'9999-12-31')

			END

THEN LPAD(Table__29."EANUPC",8,'0')

END)
ELSE
(CASE WHEN LENGTH(Table__80."EANUPC") > 0 AND LENGTH(Table__80."EANUPC") <= 8
THEN LPAD(Table__80."EANUPC",8,'0')
WHEN LENGTH(Table__80."EANUPC") > 8 AND LENGTH(Table__80."EANUPC") <= 12

WHERE "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORDAYA" = 0 and "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."0COMP_CODE" = 'US16') "Max Current Date",
(SELECT max(concat(concat(substr("_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBODATE1",7,4),substr("_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBODATE1",4,2)),substr("_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBODATE1",1,2)))
FROM "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"
WHERE "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORDAYAD" = 0 and "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."0COMP_CODE" = 'US16') "Current Date-1",
(SELECT ROUND(MAX("_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBOLCHAR"))
FROM "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"
WHERE "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORDAYA" = 0) "CY_YBOLCHAR",
(SELECT ROUND(MAX("_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBOLCHAR2"))
FROM "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"
WHERE "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORDAYA" = 0) "CY_YBOLCHAR2",
(SELECT ROUND(MAX("_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBOTRES"))
FROM "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"
WHERE "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORDAYA" = 0) "CY_YBOTRES",
(SELECT ROUND(MAX("_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBOTRES2"))
FROM "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"
WHERE "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORDAYA" = 0) "CY_YBOTRES2",
(SELECT ROUND(MAX("_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBOLCHAR")) 
FROM "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"
WHERE "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORDAYB" = 0 AND "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORYA" = -1) "LY_YBOLCHAR",
(SELECT ROUND(MAX("_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBOLCHAR2"))
FROM "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"
WHERE "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORDAYA" = 0) "LY_YBOLCHAR2",
(SELECT ROUND(MAX("_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBOTRES")) 
FROM "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC" 
WHERE "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORDAYB" = 0 AND "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORYA" = -1) "LY_YBOTRES",
(SELECT ROUND(MAX("_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBOTRES2")) 
FROM "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"
WHERE "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORDAYBD" = 0 AND "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORMTB" = 0 AND "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORYA" = -1) "LY_YBOTRES2"
FROM "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"
WHERE "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."0COMP_CODE" = 'US16'
  )  Table__16 ON (Table__17."0COMP_CODE"=Table__16."COMP_CODE")
   INNER JOIN ( 
  SELECT DISTINCT
"_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBOCALMTH" "YEAR_MONTH",
"_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORMTA",
"_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBORMTB",
"_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBOMTH_EN"
FROM 
"_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"
WHERE
"_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."YBOCALYR" <>'0000' AND
"_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"."0COMP_CODE" = 'US16'
ORDER BY 
1
  )  Table__30 ON (Table__17."0CALMONTH"=Table__30."YEAR_MONTH")
   INNER JOIN "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/YBORELTME"  Table__22 ON (Table__17."0CALDAY"=Table__22."YBORELTME"  AND  Table__22."YBORELTME" <> '')
   INNER JOIN "_SYS_BIC"."system-local.bw.bw2hana/ZBOLC"  Table__35 ON (Table__17."0DOC_DATE"=Table__35."0CALDAY")
  
WHERE
  (
   CASE WHEN Table__17."0INFOPROV" = '2HT0X2IE0GNX0H5XGR3D9O7HYSQ' THEN 
(CASE WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'USB' THEN 'USOU-BEV'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'USF' THEN 'USOU-BAKE'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'US6' THEN 'USOU-NCP'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'US8' THEN 'USOU-NHSZE'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'USL' THEN 'USOU-FDS'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'USG' THEN 'USOU-FRSH'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'USM' THEN 'USOU-NHSVI'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'USO' THEN 'USOU-HTCH'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'USP' THEN 'USOU-SE'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'USQ' THEN 'USOU-DIV'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'USW' THEN 'USOU-FTPR'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" IN ('US1' , 'US3', 'US4' , 'USZ') THEN 'USOU-NHS'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" IN ('US2','US5','US7','USD','USE','USR', 'USV','USY') THEN 'USOU-NUT'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" IN ('USC','USU','USX') THEN 'USOU-CONF'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" IN ('USH','USJ','USN') THEN 'USOU-FT'
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" IN ('USI', 'UST') THEN 'USOU-ICJV'

WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'USA' THEN
(CASE WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH3" = 'USAAA' THEN 'USOU-NHSVP' 
WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH3" = 'USAAB' THEN 'USOU-NHSNU' 
ELSE 'USOU-NHS' END)

WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'USK' THEN
(CASE WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH3" IN ('USKK9', 'USKKA','USKKH', 'USKKY') THEN 'USOU-DIVBU' ELSE 'USOU-PFC' END)

WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'USS' THEN 
(CASE WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH3" IN ('USSS6','USSS7','USSSA') THEN 'USOU-SNACK' ELSE 'USOU-PIZ' END)

WHEN Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2" = 'US9' THEN 
(CASE WHEN (Table__17."YCUSTHL1" = '0001108224' OR Table__17."YCUSTHL3" = '0006303422') THEN 'USOU-IPWFS' ELSE 'USOU-IPW' END)

END)
ELSE Table__17."0G_CWWSCR"
END  IN  ( 'USOU-NHS','USOU-NUT','US-NHSWELL','22OU-NHSHQ'  )
   AND
   Table__17."0SALESORG"  IN  ( 'US01','US04'  )
   AND
   Table__17."0DISTR_CHAN"  IN  ( '08','14'  )
   AND
   Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH2"  =  'USZ'
   AND
   Table__17."0MAT_SALES__0PRODH3"  <>  'USZZ9'
   AND
   Table__17."0REASON_REJ"  IN  ( ''  )
   AND
   Table__17."0COMP_CODE"  IN  ('US16')
   AND
   CASE 
   WHEN (Table__17."0INFOPROV"='Y5CS3BE0') THEN '010' ELSE Table__17."0VTYPE"
END   IN  ('010')
   AND
   CASE 
   WHEN (Table__17."0REC_TYPE" <> 'Z') THEN 'WOMS' ELSE 'WMS'
END  =  'WOMS'
   AND
   Table__17."0INFOPROV"  IN  ('2HT0X2IE0GNX0H5XGR3D9O7HYSQ','Y5CO1AH0','Y5CO1AH1','Y5CO1AH2','Y5CO1AH3','Y5CO1AH4','Y5CO1AH5','Y5CO1BO0','Y5CO2AH0','Y5CS3BE0','Y5GD5BE0','Y5GD4BE0','2HSE0VGEZX9PF2PKL8KAO2PYT5H')
   AND
   Table__17."0CALYEAR"  >  '2014'
   AND
   (
    Table__17."0SALESORG"  Is Not Null  
    AND
    Table__17."0SALESORG"  <>  ''
   )
   AND
   Table__17."0CALYEAR"  IN  ('@{variables('Year')}'  )
  AND (
   (CASE WHEN
      (Table__30."YBORMTA" = 0)
   THEN 
      ( ( CASE WHEN Table__17."YOPORD_GP" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE Table__17."YOPORD_GP" END )+( CASE WHEN Table__17."YOPDLVGPS" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE Table__17."YOPDLVGPS" END ) )
   END) <> 0
OR   (
   CASE WHEN
      (Table__30."YBORMTA" > 0)
   THEN 
      ( ( CASE WHEN Table__17."YOPORD_GP" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE Table__17."YOPORD_GP" END )+( CASE WHEN Table__17."YOPDLVGPS" IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE Table__17."YOPDLVGPS" END ) )
   END
)<> 0
)
)
GROUP BY

  Table__17."0DOC_NUMBER",
  Table__17."0MATERIAL"

Truncate Table dr.dimCombinedMaterialHierarchy;

 WITH ORGAIN_ITEMS AS (
     
	 SELECT 
			 [DATE]
			,[FG_Num]
			,[Item_Description]
			,convert(NVARCHAR,GTIN) as GTIN
	 FROM 
			[dr].[Orgain_Data] 
	WHERE 
				FG_Num IS NOT NULL
			AND [Reporting_Country] IN ('USA','0')
			AND [DATE] > (SELECT MAX([Invoice_Date]) ACTUALS_MAX_DATE FROM [dr].[Orgain_YTD_Actuals] WHERE [Reporting_Country] IN ('USA','0') AND [Type] IN ('INVOICE','CREDIT MEMO'))
			AND [Document_Type] in ('Invoice','Credit Memo') 

	UNION
	
	SELECT 
			 [INVOICE_DATE] "DATE"
			,[FG_Num]
			,[Item_Description]
			,GTIN

	FROM
			[dr].[Orgain_YTD_Actuals]
	WHERE
				FG_Num IS NOT NULL
			AND [Reporting_Country] IN ('USA','0')
			AND [Type] IN ('INVOICE','CREDIT MEMO')
),


Combined_Items AS (
      SELECT
        TRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR,[Product_Number])) as MaterialKey,
        TRIM(CONVERT(NVARCHAR,[Product_Number])) as MaterialID,
        [Product_Description] as MaterialDesc,
        --[Item_Number] as EANUPC,
               UPC EANUPC,
		Null as MaterialType,
		Null as ProductLevel1MarketID,
		Null as ProductLevel1MarketDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel2BusinessID,
		Null as ProductLevel2BusinessDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel3CategoryID,
		'US ' + UPPER([Item_Brand]) as ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel4SubcategoryID,
		'US ' + UPPER([Item_Brand]) ProductLevel4SubcategoryDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel5SegmentID,
		Null as ProductLevel5SegmentDescription,
		Null as Division,
		Null as Subdivision,
		Null as OPCO,
		Null as Company_Code,
		Null as Salesorg,
		Null as Distr_Chan,
		Null as CrossPlantMaterialStatus,
		Null as CorporateBrandCode,
		[Item_Brand] as CorporateBrandDescription,
		Null as RangeBrandCode,
		[Item_Brand] as RangeBrandDescription,
		Null as DenominationBrandCode,
		Null as DenominationBrandDescription,
		Null as AnimalFarm,
		'Other' as PL3NHSSales,
        1 as rn
   FROM [dr].[Atrium_dim_product_DS]

	UNION ALL

	    SELECT 
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR,[FG_Num]) as MaterialKey,
        [FG_Num] as MaterialID,
        [Item_Description] as MaterialDesc,
        GTIN as EANUPC,
		Null as MaterialType,
		Null as ProductLevel1MarketID,
		Null as ProductLevel1MarketDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel2BusinessID,
		Null as ProductLevel2BusinessDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel3CategoryID,
		'US Orgain' as ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel4SubcategoryID,
		'US Orgain' ProductLevel4SubcategoryDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel5SegmentID,
		Null as ProductLevel5SegmentDescription,
		Null as Division,
		Null as Subdivision,
		Null as OPCO,
		Null as Company_Code,
		Null as Salesorg,
		Null as Distr_Chan,
		Null as CrossPlantMaterialStatus,
		Null as CorporateBrandCode,
		'Orgain' as CorporateBrandDescription,
		Null as RangeBrandCode,
		'Orgain' as RangeBrandDescription,
		Null as DenominationBrandCode,
		Null as DenominationBrandDescription,
		Null as AnimalFarm,
		'Other' as PL3NHSSales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [FG_Num] ORDER BY [Item_Description] DESC, [DATE] DESC) AS rn
    FROM ORGAIN_ITEMS

	UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CONVERT(NVARCHAR,[ITEM]) as MaterialKey,
        [ITEM] as MaterialID,
        [ITEM_DESCRIPTION] as MaterialDesc,
        [UPC] as EANUPC,
		Null as MaterialType,
		Null as ProductLevel1MarketID,
		Null as ProductLevel1MarketDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel2BusinessID,
		Null as ProductLevel2BusinessDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel3CategoryID,
		'US ' + UPPER(BRAND) as ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel4SubcategoryID,
		'US ' + UPPER([Brand]) + ' ' + [UNIT_OF_MEASURE] ProductLevel4SubcategoryDescription,
		Null as ProductLevel5SegmentID,
		Null as ProductLevel5SegmentDescription,
		Null as Division,
		Null as Subdivision,
		Null as OPCO,
		Null as Company_Code,
		Null as Salesorg,
		Null as Distr_Chan,
		Null as CrossPlantMaterialStatus,
		Null as CorporateBrandCode,
		BRAND as CorporateBrandDescription,
		Null as RangeBrandCode,
		UPPER(BRAND) as RangeBrandDescription,
		Null as DenominationBrandCode,
		Null as DenominationBrandDescription,
		Null as AnimalFarm,
		'Other' as PL3NHSSales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [ITEM] ORDER BY ordered_Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM [dr].[GOL_SKU_Revenue]
	WHERE
		--690 – Employee Expense
		--691 – Friends and Family
		--514,052,050,512 International Cost Centers
		[SALESREP_CC] NOT IN ('514', '052', '050', '512','690','691')
	AND BRAND IS NOT NULL

	UNION ALL

	SELECT CONVERT(NVARCHAR,N1.MaterialKey) AS MaterialKey,
		N1.MaterialID,
		N1.MaterialDesc,
		N1.EANUPC,
		N1.MaterialType,
		N1.ProductLevel1MarketID,
		N1.ProductLevel1MarketDescription,
		N1.ProductLevel2BusinessID,
		N1.ProductLevel2BusinessDescription,
		N1.ProductLevel3CategoryID,
		CASE 
			--WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription='US VMHS NBTY BROADLINE' THEN 'US VMHS NATURE’S BOUNTY' 
			WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription='US ORGAIN' THEN 'US-ORGAIN'
			ELSE N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription 
			END ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
		N1.ProductLevel4SubcategoryID,
		N1.ProductLevel4SubcategoryDescription,
		N1.ProductLevel5SegmentID,
		N1.ProductLevel5SegmentDescription,
		N1.Division,
		N1.Subdivision,
		N1.OPCO,
		N1.Company_Code,
		N1.Salesorg,
		N1.Distr_Chan,
		N1.CrossPlantMaterialStatus,
		N1.CorporateBrandCode,
		N1.CorporateBrandDescription,
		N1.RangeBrandCode,
		N1.RangeBrandDescription,
		N1.DenominationBrandCode,
		N1.DenominationBrandDescription,
		N1.AnimalFarm,
		(CASE WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription  like 'US%NUUN%' THEN 'US NUUN'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription ='US BOOST' THEN 'US BOOST'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription ='US BOOST KID ESSENTIALS' THEN 'US BOOST KID ESSENTIALS'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription ='US CBE' THEN 'US CBE'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription ='US CELLTRIENT' THEN 'US CELLTRIENT'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription like 'US%GUT HEALTH%' THEN 'US GUT HEALTH'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription='US ALLERGY' AND MaterialKey = 12411802 THEN 'US EHA'
		WHEN N1.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription like 'US VMHS%' THEN 'US VMHS'
		ELSE 'Other'
		END) PL3NHSSales,
		1 as rn
	FROM [dr].[DimMaterialMaster] N1

)

INSERT INTO dr.dimCombinedMaterialHierarchy

SELECT 
		MaterialKey,
		MaterialID,
		MaterialDesc,
		EANUPC,
		MaterialType,
		ProductLevel1MarketID,
		ProductLevel1MarketDescription,

		ProductLevel2BusinessDescription,
		ProductLevel3CategoryID,
		C.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
		ProductLevel4SubcategoryID,
		ProductLevel4SubcategoryDescription,
		ProductLevel5SegmentID,
		ProductLevel5SegmentDescription,
		Division,
		Subdivision,
		OPCO,
		Company_Code,
		Salesorg,
		Distr_Chan,
		CrossPlantMaterialStatus,
		CorporateBrandCode,
		CorporateBrandDescription,
		RangeBrandCode,
		RangeBrandDescription,
		DenominationBrandCode,

activities.name: Populate POS Table with Medical Nutrition Data

scripts.text:
DELETE 
FROM [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]
WHERE [Source] IN ('MEDICAL NUTRITION');

WITH  MATERIAL_MASTER AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        LEFT(RIGHT([EANUPC], 11), 10) AS UPC,
        CASE 
            WHEN MaterialType IS NULL THEN 'NON SAP Brand'
            ELSE 'SAP Brand'
        END AS SAP_BRAND
    FROM 
        [dr].[dimCombinedMaterialHierarchy]
    WHERE 
        RIGHT(ISNULL(MaterialKey, ''), 4) <> '-ISC' 
        AND ISNULL(CrossPlantMaterialStatus, 'Null') IN (
            'Z3 Active',
            'Z2 Pre-Go Decision',
            'Z4 Under Discontinuation',
            'Null'
        )  
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel2BusinessDescription, '') <> 'US VMHS EXPORT'
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel3CategoryDescription, '') NOT IN ('US VMHS SOLGAR', 'US-ORGAIN')
),

POS_Sales AS (

SELECT 
		 S.[Period_Id] AS "Sale_Date"
		,ST.[State_Fullname] AS [State]
		,M.[UPC] Matched_UPC
		,M.[EANUPC] AS Source_UPC
		,S.MaterialDesc AS Source_UPC_Description
		,M.MaterialKey AS MaterialKey
		,M.MaterialDesc
		,SUM(S.[GPS]) AS Dollar_Sales
		,SUM(S.[Cases]*S.[CasePackQty]) AS Unit_Sales
		,'MEDICAL NUTRITION' AS "Source"
FROM 
		[dr].[ERP_MN_Direct_Indirect_Sales] S

LEFT JOIN 
			MATERIAL_MASTER M ON M.MATERIALID=S.SourceMaterialId
JOIN 
			dr.ERP_State_Mapping AS ST ON ST.[STATE]=S.[State] AND ERP_Flag=1

WHERE

		YEAR(S.[Period_Id])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)

GROUP BY
		 S.[Period_Id]
		,ST.[State_Fullname]
		,M.[UPC]
		,M.[EANUPC]
		,S.MaterialDesc
		,M.MaterialKey 
		,M.MaterialDesc

)

INSERT INTO [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]

SELECT 
    pos.[Sale_Date],
    pos.[State],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(400), CASE WHEN pos.[Matched_UPC] = '' THEN NULL ELSE pos.[Matched_UPC] END) AS Matched_UPC,
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC_Description]) AS [Source_UPC_Description],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC]) AS Source_UPC,
    pos.[MaterialKey],
    pos.[Source],
    pos.[Dollar_Sales],
    pos.[Unit_Sales],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), CONCAT(
									B.[Bill Of Material], '-', 
									B.[MaterialKey], '-', 
									B.[Component], '-', 
									B.[Alternative BOM], '-', 
									b.state, '-', 
									b.[valid from], '-', 
									b.[Valid To], '-', 
									REPLACE(B.[Change No.], ' ', ''), '-',
									REPLACE(B.[Change No. To], ' ', ''), '-',
									[Item ID]
									)
			) AS "BOM KEY"
FROM 

    POS_Sales pos

LEFT JOIN 
			[dr].[BOM_CAA_Mapping] b ON pos.MaterialKey = b.MaterialKey 
										AND pos.State = b.State 
										AND b.[Valid To] >= pos.Sale_Date 
										AND b.[valid from] <= pos.Sale_Date

DELETE 
FROM [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]
WHERE [Source] IN ('CIRCANA');

WITH  MATERIAL_MASTER AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        LEFT(RIGHT([EANUPC], 11), 10) AS UPC,
        CASE 
            WHEN MaterialType IS NULL THEN 'NON SAP Brand'
            ELSE 'SAP Brand'
        END AS SAP_BRAND
    FROM 
        [dr].[dimCombinedMaterialHierarchy]
    WHERE 
        RIGHT(ISNULL(MaterialKey, ''), 4) <> '-ISC' 
        AND ISNULL(CrossPlantMaterialStatus, 'Null') IN (
            'Z3 Active',
            'Z2 Pre-Go Decision',
            'Z4 Under Discontinuation',
            'Null'
        )  
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel2BusinessDescription, '') <> 'US VMHS EXPORT'
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel3CategoryDescription, '') NOT IN ('US VMHS SOLGAR', 'US-ORGAIN')
),

CIRCAN_MATCH_UPC AS (

SELECT	 

			 F.[Date] Sale_Date
			,ST.[State_Fullname] AS [State]
			,M.[UPC] Matched_UPC
			,CM.UPC_10_digit AS Source_UPC
			,CM.Product_Description Source_UPC_Description
			,M.MaterialKey
			,M.MaterialDesc
			,SUM(F.Dollar_Sales) Dollar_Sales
			,SUM(F.Unit_Sales) Unit_Sales
			,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY F.[Date],ST.[State_Fullname],CM.UPC_10_digit ORDER BY ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM [dr].[COMPLETE_BOM] WHERE F.[Date] BETWEEN [Valid From] AND [Valid To] AND MATERIALID=[SAP Material Number]),2),MATERIALKEY DESC) RN
			,'CIRCANA' AS [Source]

  FROM 
			[dr].[Circana_Consumption_Fact] F
  JOIN 
			[dr].[Circana_Product_Master] CM ON CM.Product_Key=F.Product_Key
  LEFT JOIN 
			MATERIAL_MASTER M ON M.[UPC]=CM.UPC_10_digit
  JOIN 
			[dr].[Circana_Market] G ON G.[Geography_Key]=F.[Geography_Key]
  JOIN 
			dr.ERP_State_Mapping AS ST ON ST.[State_Fullname]=SUBSTRING([Geography_Description], 1, CHARINDEX('-', [Geography_Description]) - 2) AND ERP_Flag=1



  WHERE 

					YEAR(F.[Date])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)
			  AND	
					Custom_Manufacturer_Value='NESTLE'
			  AND	
					FileType='NutritionAdult'
   
 group by 
			 [Date]
			,ST.[State_Fullname]
			,M.[UPC]
			,CM.UPC_10_digit
			,CM.Product_Description
			,MaterialKey
			,MaterialDesc
			,MATERIALID
		),

POS_Sales AS (
    SELECT 
		 [Sale_Date]
		,[State]
		,Matched_UPC
		,Source_UPC
		,[Source_UPC_Description]
		,[MaterialKey]
		,[MaterialDesc]
		,[Dollar_Sales]
		,[Unit_Sales]
		,[Source]

FROM 
		CIRCAN_MATCH_UPC
WHERE RN=1

)

INSERT INTO [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]

SELECT 
    pos.[Sale_Date],
    pos.[State],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(400), CASE WHEN pos.[Matched_UPC] = '' THEN NULL ELSE pos.[Matched_UPC] END) AS Matched_UPC,
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC_Description]) AS [Source_UPC_Description],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC]) AS Source_UPC,
    pos.[MaterialKey],
    pos.[Source],
    pos.[Dollar_Sales],
    pos.[Unit_Sales],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), CONCAT(
									B.[Bill Of Material], '-', 
									B.[MaterialKey], '-', 
									B.[Component], '-', 
									B.[Alternative BOM], '-', 
									b.state, '-', 
									b.[valid from], '-', 
									b.[Valid To], '-', 
									REPLACE(B.[Change No.], ' ', ''), '-',
									REPLACE(B.[Change No. To], ' ', ''), '-',
									[Item ID]
									)
			) AS "BOM KEY"
FROM 

    POS_Sales pos

LEFT JOIN 
			[dr].[BOM_CAA_Mapping] b ON pos.MaterialKey = b.MaterialKey 
										AND pos.State = b.State 
										AND b.[Valid To] >= pos.Sale_Date 
										AND b.[valid from] <= pos.Sale_Date

source.query:
WITH REST AS(
--NONULLS
SELECT
MCHB."MATNR",
REGEXP_REPLACE(MCHB."MATNR", '^0+', '') PRODUCT,
MCHB.WERKS as PLANT,
T006A.MSEH3 UOM, 
--MCHB.CLABS,
--MARM.UMREZ,
ROUND(COALESCE((MCHB.CLABS/MARM.UMREZ),MCHB.CLABS)) QTY

FROM "EDW"."PRS"."S6_ERPAMS_MCHB_V"  MCHB
JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_MARC_V" MARC
ON MCHB.MATNR = MARC.MATNR
AND MCHB.WERKS = MARC.WERKS
JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_MARA_V as MARA
ON MARA.MATNR = MARC.MATNR
LEFT JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_MARM_V" MARM
ON MCHB.MATNR = MARM.MATNR
AND MARC.AUSME = MARM.MEINH
LEFT JOIN  "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_T006A_V" T006A 
ON MARM.MEINH = T006A.MSEHI
AND SPRAS = 'E'
WHERE 1=1
AND MCHB.WERKS IN ('UM09','UM10' ,'UM13')
AND CLABS != 0 
--AND LEFT(PRODUCT,3) = 442),
--AND PRODUCT LIKE '%44305837'
--ORDER BY QTY
),
RESTFIX AS(
SELECT 
REST.MATNR,
PRODUCT,
PLANT,
MSEH3 UOM, 
QTY
FROM REST REST
JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_MARA_V as MARA
ON MARA.MATNR = REST.MATNR
LEFT JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_MARM_V" MARM
ON MARA.MATNR = MARM.MATNR
AND MARA.MEINS = MARM.MEINH
LEFT JOIN  "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_T006A_V" T006A 
ON MARM.MEINH = T006A.MSEHI
AND SPRAS = 'E'
WHERE REST.UOM IS NULL
),

FIVE AS(
--ITEMS AS 105
SELECT DISTINCT 
MARD.MATNR,
REGEXP_REPLACE(mard."MATNR", '^0+', '') Product,
MARD.WERKS PLANT,
MSEH3 UOM,
LABST QTY
FROM   "EDW"."PRS"."S6_ERPAMS_MARD_V" MARD 
JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_MARA_V as MARA
ON MARA.MATNR = MARD.MATNR
LEFT JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_MARM_V" MARM
ON MARA.MATNR = MARM.MATNR
AND MARA.MEINS = MARM.MEINH
LEFT JOIN  "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_T006A_V" T006A 
ON MARM.MEINH = T006A.MSEHI
AND SPRAS = 'E'

WHERE MARD.WERKS IN ('UM09','UM10' ,'UM13')
AND LEFT(REGEXP_REPLACE(mard."MATNR", '^0+', ''),3)=105
AND LABST != 0
),

SUBREST AS(
SELECT * FROM RESTFIX
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM REST WHERE UOM IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM FIVE
)



SELECT 
PRODUCT,
PLANT,
UOM,
ROUND(QTY) QTY
FROM SUBREST
ORDER BY PLANT,PRODUCT,QTY

ifTrueActivities.name: Populate POS Table with Atrium Amazon Data

scripts.text:
DELETE 
FROM [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]
WHERE [Source] IN ('AMAZON-ATRIUM');

WITH  POS_Sales AS (
SELECT 
		 AA.[Month] AS "Sale_Date"
		,AA.[Ship to State / Point of Sale State] AS "State"
		,M.[UPC] Matched_UPC
		,AA.[UPC] Source_UPC
		,AA.[SKU Description] Source_UPC_Description
		--,[Unit of Measure]
		,REPLACE(M.[MaterialKey],Concat('_',CorporateBrandDescription),'') AS MaterialKey
		,M.[MaterialDesc]
		,NULL AS "Dollar_Sales"
		,AA.[Units Sold] AS "Unit_Sales"
		,'AMAZON-ATRIUM' AS "Source"
      
	FROM 
			[dr].[ERP_Atrium_Amazon] AA

	JOIN 
			dr.ERP_State_Mapping AS ST ON ST.[State_Fullname]=AA.[Ship to State / Point of Sale State] AND ST.[ERP_Flag]=1 

	LEFT JOIN 
			dr.ERP_UPC_Mapping M ON M.[EANUPC]=AA.[UPC]  AND NHS='ATRIUM PRO'

	WHERE 

			YEAR(AA.[Month])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)
			

)

INSERT INTO [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]

SELECT 
    pos.[Sale_Date],
    pos.[State],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(400), CASE WHEN pos.[Matched_UPC] = '' THEN NULL ELSE pos.[Matched_UPC] END) AS Matched_UPC,
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC_Description]) AS [Source_UPC_Description],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC]) AS Source_UPC,
    pos.[MaterialKey],
    pos.[Source],
    pos.[Dollar_Sales],
    pos.[Unit_Sales],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), CONCAT(
									B.[Bill Of Material], '-', 
									B.[MaterialKey], '-', 
									B.[Component], '-', 
									B.[Alternative BOM], '-', 
									b.state, '-', 
									b.[valid from], '-', 
									b.[Valid To], '-', 
									REPLACE(B.[Change No.], ' ', ''), '-',
									REPLACE(B.[Change No. To], ' ', ''), '-',
									[Item ID]
									)
			) AS "BOM KEY"
FROM 

    POS_Sales pos

LEFT JOIN 
			[dr].[BOM_CAA_Mapping] b ON pos.MaterialKey = b.MaterialKey 
										AND pos.State = b.State 
										AND b.[Valid To] >= pos.Sale_Date 
										AND b.[valid from] <= pos.Sale_Date

		,M.MaterialDesc
		,Null AS Dollar_Sales
		,SUM(CONVERT(FLOAT,CO.[POS Unit Sales])) AS Unit_Sales
		,'COSTCO-ORGAIN' AS "Source"

FROM 
		[dr].[ERP_Costco_Orgain] CO

	LEFT JOIN 
			dr.ERP_UPC_Mapping M ON M.[EANUPC]=CO.[UPC]
	JOIN 
			dr.ERP_State_Mapping AS ST ON ST.[STATE]=CO.[Venue] AND ERP_Flag=1
  WHERE

		YEAR(CO.[Time])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)
  
  GROUP BY 
		 CO.[Time]
		,ST.[State_Fullname]
		--,SUBSTRING(CO.Item,16,LEN(CO.Item)-16)
		,M.[UPC]
		,CO.[UPC]
		,M.MaterialKey
		,M.MaterialDesc

)

scripts.text:
IF OBJECT_ID('dt.NHSc_BOM_Item_Dedup','U') IS NOT NULL  

BEGIN

truncate table dt.NHSc_BOM_Item_Dedup;
drop table dt.NHSc_BOM_Item_Dedup;
WITH BOM AS (
SELECT
						 L.[BillOfMaterial] 
						,L.AlternativeBOM 
						,L.Plant 
						,MaterialNumber 
						,I.BOMItemNumber
						,I.ItemCategoryBillOfMaterial 
						,I.[BOMComponent]
						,ComponentQuantity
						,BOMItemNodeNumber
						,I.NameOfPersonWhoChangedObject
						,ValidFromDate 
						,ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 convert(Date,[Valid-FromDate]) FROM [dr].[NHSC_BOM_Selection_FullLoad] IX WHERE I.BillOfMaterial=IX.BillOfMaterial AND I.BOMCategory=IX.BOMCategory AND I.BOMItemNodeNumber=IX.BOMItemNodeNumber AND IX.AlternativeBOM=L.AlternativeBOM and ISNULL(I.DeletionIndicator,'')<>ISNULL(IX.DeletionIndicator,'') ORDER BY InternalCounter DESC),'9999-12-31') AS "ValidToDate"
						,I.ChangeNumber 
						,SortString 
						,I.InheritedNodeNumberOfBOMItem 
						,(SELECT TOP 1 IX.[ChangeNumber] FROM [dr].[NHSC_BOM_Selection_FullLoad] IX WHERE I.BillOfMaterial=IX.BillOfMaterial AND I.BOMCategory=IX.BOMCategory AND I.BOMItemNodeNumber=IX.BOMItemNodeNumber AND IX.AlternativeBOM=L.AlternativeBOM and ISNULL(I.DeletionIndicator,'')<>ISNULL(IX.DeletionIndicator,'') ORDER BY InternalCounter DESC) AS "ChangeNoTo"
						,I.FixedQty AS "Fixed Quantity"
						,I.BOMCategory
 
 
							FROM
										[dr].[NHSC_BOM_Item_FullLoad] I
							JOIN
										[dr].[NHSC_BOM_Link_FullLoad] L ON L.[BillOfMaterial]=I.[BillOfMaterial]
					
							WHERE
										    1=1
									--AND CONVERT(BIGINT,MaterialNumber) IN ('11001937')  AND L.Plant='5880' 
									--AND I.BOMCategory='M' 
									--AND I.[BOMComponent]='000000000022011304'
									AND EXISTS (
												SELECT 1
												FROM [dr].[NHSC_BOM_Selection_FullLoad] S
												WHERE S.BillOfMaterial = I.BillOfMaterial
													AND S.BOMItemNodeNumber = I.BOMItemNodeNumber
													AND S.BOMCategory = I.BOMCategory
													AND AlternativeBOM=L.AlternativeBOM
												)
			)
 
SELECT * into dt.NHSc_BOM_Item_Dedup FROM BOM
END;

IF OBJECT_ID('dr.MaterialConsolidatedData','U') IS NOT NULL  

BEGIN

truncate table dr.MaterialConsolidatedData;
drop table dr.MaterialConsolidatedData;


select N3.*,
cast(null as varchar(100)) MaterialPlantStatus,
cast(null as varchar(100)) MaterialPlantStatusValidDate,
cast(N5.[PlantSpecificMaterialStatusID] as varchar(100)) CompMaterialPlantStatus,
cast(N5.[PlantSpecificMaterialStatusValidityStartDate] as varchar(100)) CompMaterialPlantStatusValidDate,
cast(null as varchar(50)) ComponentMaterialType,
cast(null as varchar(50)) LocalAttribute1,
cast(null as varchar(50)) LocalAttribute2,
cast(null as varchar(50)) LocalAttribute3,
'CHILD' BaseChildMaterial,
cast(N1.BillOfMaterial as varchar) BillOfMaterial,
cast(N1.AlternativeBOM as varchar) AlternativeBOM,
cast(BOMStatus as varchar) BOMStatus,
cast([Valid-FromDate] as varchar) BOMValidFromDate,
cast(N1.BOMComponent as varchar(100)) BOMComponent,
cast(null as varchar(500)) BOMComponentDescription,
cast(null as varchar(200)) BOMComponentStatus,
cast(N1.BOMItemNodeNumber as varchar) BOMItemNodeNumber,
cast(N1.ValidFromDate as varchar) BOMItemValidFromDate ,
cast(N1.ValidToDate as varchar) BOMItemValidToDate,
N1.NameOfPersonWhoChangedObject ChangedBy,
N1.ComponentQuantity,N1.Plant,
cast(null as varchar(50)) TBCOOracleNumber ,
cast(null as varchar(50)) TBCOAS400Number, 
cast(null as varchar(50)) TBCOAS400Suffix,
cast(null as varchar(50)) SKUDiscontinuationFlag,
cast(0 as float) DemandQuantitySixMonths,
cast(0 as float) AS400InventoryQuantity,
cast(0 as float) AS400InventoryValue,
cast(null as varchar(10)) AS400InventoryUOM,
cast(0 as float) TotalBatchStockBaseUOM,
cast(0 as float) TotalBatchStockValue,
cast(null as varchar(100)) TBCOEBSPurchaseOrder,
cast(0 as float) TBCOEBSPOQuantity,
cast(0 as float) TBCOEBSPOQuantityReceived,
cast(null as varchar(500)) SAPPurchaseOrder,
cast(0 as float) SAPPOQuantity,
cast(0 as float) SAPPOQuantityReceived
into dr.MaterialConsolidatedData from dt.NHSc_BOM_Item_Dedup N1,
dr.DimMaterialMaster N3,
dr.NHSc_BOM_Header N4, dr.Dim_MaterialMasterPlantData N5 where N3.Company_Code='US8X'
and N3.MaterialID=N1.MaterialNumber
and N1.BillOfMaterial=N4.BillOfMaterial
and N1.AlternativeBOM=N4.AlternativeBOM
and N1.BOMComponent=N5.MaterialID
and N5.LocationID=N1.Plant
union all
select N3.*,
cast(N5.[PlantSpecificMaterialStatusID] as varchar(100)) MaterialPlantStatus,
cast(N5.[PlantSpecificMaterialStatusValidityStartDate] as varchar(100)) MaterialPlantStatusValidDate,
cast(null as varchar(100)) CompMaterialPlantStatus,
cast(null as varchar(100)) CompMaterialPlantStatusValidDate,
cast(null as varchar(50)) ComponentMaterialType,
cast(null as varchar(50)) LocalAttribute1,
cast(null as varchar(50)) LocalAttribute2,
cast(null as varchar(50)) LocalAttribute3,
'BASE' BaseChildMaterial,
cast(null as varchar(500)) BillOfMaterial,
cast(null as varchar(10)) AlternativeBOM,
cast(null as varchar) BOMStatus,
cast(null as varchar) BOMValidFromDate,
cast(null as varchar(500)) BOMComponent,
cast(null as varchar) BOMComponentDescription,
cast(null as varchar(200)) BOMComponentStatus,
cast(null as varchar(500)) BOMItemNodeNumber,
cast(null as varchar) BOMItemValidFromDate,
cast(null as varchar) BOMItemValidToDate,
cast(null as varchar) ChangedBy,
cast(0 as decimal(10,3)) ComponentQuantity,
cast(N5.LocationID as varchar(50)) Plant,
cast(null as varchar(50)) TBCOOracleNumber ,
cast(null as varchar(50)) TBCOAS400Number, 
cast(null as varchar(50)) TBCOAS400Suffix,
cast(null as varchar(50)) SKUDiscontinuationFlag,
cast(0 as float) DemandQuantitySixMonths,
cast(0 as float) AS400InventoryQuantity,
cast(0 as float) AS400InventoryValue,
cast(null as varchar(10)) AS400InventoryUOM,
cast(0 as float) TotalBatchStockBaseUOM,
cast(0 as float) TotalBatchStockValue,
cast(null as varchar(100)) TBCOEBSPurchaseOrder,
cast(0 as float) TBCOEBSPOQuantity,
cast(0 as float) TBCOEBSPOQuantityReceived,
cast(null as varchar(500)) SAPPurchaseOrder,
cast(0 as float) SAPPOQuantity,
cast(0 as float) SAPPOQuantityReceived
 from dr.DimMaterialMaster N3 ,dr.Dim_MaterialMasterPlantData N5
where N3.Company_Code='US8X' and  N3.MaterialID=N5.MaterialID;

END;

WITH TBCOMAT(SAPMaterialNumber,OracleNumber,AS400Number,Suffix) AS
(select N2.SAPMaterialNumber,N1.OracleNumber,
N1.[AS400 #] AS400Number,isnull(N1.[Primary Suffix],N1.[AS400 Trans Primary Suffix]) Suffix
from dr.TBCOMaterialMaster
N1,dr.TBCOSAPMaterialCrossReference N2
where N2.TBCOOracleNumber=N1.OracleNumber)
update dr.MaterialConsolidatedData
set TBCOOracleNumber=N2.OracleNumber,
TBCOAS400Number=N2.AS400Number,
TBCOAS400Suffix=N2.Suffix
FROM dr.MaterialConsolidatedData N1
INNER JOIN TBCOMAT AS N2 ON ((
CASE WHEN N1.BaseChildMaterial='CHILD' THEN N1.BOMComponent
ELSE N1.MaterialID END)=N2.SAPMaterialNumber)
;

WITH MATTYPE (MaterialID,MaterialDesc,ComponentMaterialType,CrossPlantMaterialStatus) AS (select
MaterialID,MaterialDesc,MaterialType ComponentMaterialType,CrossPlantMaterialStatus from dr.DimMaterialMaster
group by MaterialID,MaterialDesc,MaterialType,CrossPlantMaterialStatus)
update dr.MaterialConsolidatedData
set ComponentMaterialType=N2.ComponentMaterialType,
    BOMComponentDescription=N2.MaterialDesc,
    BOMComponentStatus=N2.CrossPlantMaterialStatus
FROM dr.MaterialConsolidatedData N1
INNER JOIN MATTYPE AS N2 ON (N1.BOMComponent=N2.MaterialID)
WHERE N1.BaseChildMaterial='CHILD';

WITH MATSTATUS 
(MaterialNumber,Plant,MaterialPlantStatus,MaterialPlantStatusValidDate) AS (
SELECT N5.MaterialID MaterialNumber,N5.LocationID Plant,
cast(N5.[PlantSpecificMaterialStatusID] as varchar(100)) MaterialPlantStatus,
cast(N5.[PlantSpecificMaterialStatusValidityStartDate] as varchar(100)) 
MaterialPlantStatusValidDate FROM dr.Dim_MaterialMasterPlantData N5
group by N5.MaterialID,N5.LocationID,
cast(N5.[PlantSpecificMaterialStatusID] as varchar(100)) ,
cast(N5.[PlantSpecificMaterialStatusValidityStartDate] as varchar(100))
)
update dr.MaterialConsolidatedData
set MaterialPlantStatus=N2.MaterialPlantStatus,
MaterialPlantStatusValidDate=N2.MaterialPlantStatusValidDate
FROM dr.MaterialConsolidatedData N1
INNER JOIN MATSTATUS AS N2 ON (N1.MaterialID=N2.MaterialNumber
and N1.Plant=N2.Plant)
WHERE N1.BaseChildMaterial='CHILD';

WITH LOCALATT (MaterialNumber,LocalAttribute1,LocalAttribute2,
LocalAttribute3) AS (select MaterialNumber,LocalAttribute1,LocalAttribute2,
LocalAttribute3 from dr.NHSC_SalesDataForMaterial N1
where SalesOrganization in ('US8R','US8O')
group by MaterialNumber,LocalAttribute1,LocalAttribute2,
LocalAttribute3)
update dr.MaterialConsolidatedData
set LocalAttribute1=N9.LocalAttribute1,
    LocalAttribute2=N9.LocalAttribute2,
    LocalAttribute3=N9.LocalAttribute3
FROM dr.MaterialConsolidatedData N1
INNER JOIN LOCALATT AS N9 ON (N1.BOMComponent=N9.MaterialNumber)
WHERE N1.BaseChildMaterial='CHILD';

WITH LOCALATT (MaterialNumber,LocalAttribute1,LocalAttribute2,
LocalAttribute3) AS (select MaterialNumber,LocalAttribute1,LocalAttribute2,
LocalAttribute3 from dr.NHSC_SalesDataForMaterial N1
where SalesOrganization in ('US8R','US8O')
group by MaterialNumber,LocalAttribute1,LocalAttribute2,
LocalAttribute3)
update dr.MaterialConsolidatedData
set LocalAttribute1=N9.LocalAttribute1,
    LocalAttribute2=N9.LocalAttribute2,
    LocalAttribute3=N9.LocalAttribute3
FROM dr.MaterialConsolidatedData N1
INNER JOIN LOCALATT AS N9 ON (N1.MaterialID=N9.MaterialNumber)
WHERE N1.BaseChildMaterial='BASE';

WITH AS400STOCK (TBCOOracleNumber,AS400InventoryQuantity,AS400InventoryValue,AS400InventoryUOM)
AS (select Oracle_number TBCOOracleNumber,sum(Qty) AS400InventoryQuantity,
sum(Total_Cost) AS400InventoryValue,
max(UOM) AS400InventoryUOM from dr.TBCOAS400InventoryExpiration
group by Oracle_number)
update dr.MaterialConsolidatedData
set AS400InventoryUOM=N2.AS400InventoryUOM,
AS400InventoryQuantity=N2.AS400InventoryQuantity,
AS400InventoryValue=N2.AS400InventoryValue
FROM dr.MaterialConsolidatedData N1
INNER JOIN AS400STOCK AS N2 ON (N1.TBCOOracleNumber=N2.TBCOOracleNumber);

WITH BATCHSTOCK
(MATERIAL_NUMBER,Plant,TotalBatchStockBaseUOM,TotalBatchStockValue
) AS (select MATERIAL_NUMBER,Plant,sum(Total_Batch_Stock_Base_UOM) TotalBatchStockBaseUOM,
sum(Total_Batch_Stock_Value) TotalBatchStockValue
from dr.rpt_AgeingReport
group by Material_Number,Plant)
update dr.MaterialConsolidatedData
set TotalBatchStockBaseUOM=N2.TotalBatchStockBaseUOM,
TotalBatchStockValue=N2.TotalBatchStockValue
FROM dr.MaterialConsolidatedData N1
INNER JOIN BATCHSTOCK AS N2 ON (
(
CASE WHEN N1.BaseChildMaterial='CHILD' THEN N1.BOMComponent
ELSE N1.MaterialID END)=N2.MATERIAL_NUMBER
and N1.Plant=N2.Plant);

WITH DEMANDQTY(Material,DemandQuantitySixMonths) AS (
select Material,sum(Case WHEN cast(CalendarMonth+'01' as date) 
>=cast(cast(year(getdate()-1) as varchar)+
right('00'+cast(month(getdate()-1) as varchar),2)+'01' as date)
and cast(CalendarMonth+'01' as date)  <=dateadd(month,6,cast(cast(year(getdate()-1) as varchar)+
right('00'+cast(month(getdate()-1) as varchar),2)+'01' as date)) THEN
FinalCDPQuantity else 0 end) DemandQuantitySixMonths
from dr.DemandPlanningReportWithLagData
group by Material)
update dr.MaterialConsolidatedData
set DemandQuantitySixMonths=N2.DemandQuantitySixMonths
FROM dr.MaterialConsolidatedData N1
INNER JOIN DEMANDQTY AS N2 ON ((CASE WHEN N1.BaseChildMaterial='CHILD' THEN N1.BOMComponent
ELSE N1.MaterialID END)=N2.Material)
;

WITH TBCOEBSPO(TBCOOracleNumber,TBCOEBSQuantity,TBCOEBSPOQuantityReceived,TBCOEBSPurchaseOrder) AS (
select OracleNumber TBCOOracleNumber,
sum(Quantity) TBCOEBSQuantity,
sum(QuantityReceived) TBCOEBSPOQuantityReceived,
max(PurchaseOrder) TBCOEBSPurchaseOrder from dt.TBCOEBSOpenPO N1,dr.TBCOMaterialMaster N2
where N1.[ItemID]=N2.[Inventory Item Id]
group by OracleNumber
)
update dr.MaterialConsolidatedData
set TBCOEBSPOQuantity=N2.TBCOEBSQuantity,
TBCOEBSPOQuantityReceived=N2.TBCOEBSPOQuantityReceived,
TBCOEBSPurchaseOrder=N2.TBCOEBSPurchaseOrder
FROM dr.MaterialConsolidatedData N1
INNER JOIN TBCOEBSPO AS N2 ON (N1.TBCOOracleNumber=N2.TBCOOracleNumber);

WITH SAPOPENPO(Material,SAPPurchaseOrder,SAPPOQuantity) AS (
select  EKPO.MATNR Material,
max(EKPO.EBELN) SAPPurchaseOrder,
sum(cast(EKPO.MENGE as decimal(20,3))) 
SAPPOQuantity
from dr.NHSC_3PL_Inbound_EKPO EKPO,
dr.DimMaterialMaster N2
WHERE EKPO.MATNR=N2.MaterialID
and ISNULL(EKPO.LOEKZ,'N') <>'L'
and ISNULL(EKPO.IS_DELETED,'N')='N'
and EKPO.MENGE <> 0
and MATNR is not null
group by EKPO.MATNR
)
update dr.MaterialConsolidatedData
set SAPPurchaseOrder=N2.SAPPurchaseOrder,
    SAPPOQuantity=N2.SAPPOQuantity
FROM dr.MaterialConsolidatedData N1
INNER JOIN SAPOPENPO AS N2 ON 
((CASE WHEN N1.BaseChildMaterial='CHILD' THEN 
N1.BOMComponent ELSE N1.MaterialID END)=N2.Material)

update  dr.MaterialConsolidatedData
set SKUDiscontinuationFlag='Y'
where cast(MaterialKey as varchar) in (select FERTMaterialNumber from dr.MaterialSKUOptimization
where FERTMaterialNumber is not null
group by FERTMaterialNumber);

WITH Current_Week AS		(
						SELECT  
								[Year Week No.] Current_ID
						FROM 
								[dr].[calendar]
						WHERE
								[DATE]=CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())
					),

List_Of_Weeks AS (
						SELECT TOP 52
								[Year Week No.], ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY [Year Week No.] DESC) RN
						FROM 
								[dr].[calendar]
						WHERE
								[Year Week No.]<(SELECT Current_ID FROM Current_Week)
						GROUP BY
						
								[Year Week No.]
						ORDER BY [Year Week No.] DESC
						
  ),

 LY_WK AS (
 						SELECT
								[Year Week No.], ROW_NUMBER () OVER (PARTITION BY 1 ORDER BY [Year Week No.] DESC) RN
						FROM
