scripts.text:
DELETE 
FROM [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]
WHERE [Source] IN ('ATRIUM POS','ATRIUM Direct Shipments');

WITH ATRIUM_POS AS (

SELECT 
		 [Year Month] AS "Sale_Date"
		,ST.[State_Fullname] AS "STATE"
		,[UPC]
		,Null Source_UPC_Description
		,[Material ID (JDE)] AS MaterialKey
		,max([Material Description]) AS MaterialDesc
		,Null AS Dollar_Sales
		,SUM(ISNULL(CONVERT(FLOAT,[Sales Quantity]),0)) AS Unit_Sales
		,'ATRIUM POS' AS "Source"

	FROM 
		[dr].[ERP_Atrium_Sales] Atr
	
	JOIN
		[dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON ST.[STATE]=[Ship To Customer State] AND ERP_Flag=1
	
	WHERE
			YEAR([Year Month])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)
		AND TRIM([Ship To Customer Type]) IN (
												'DIRECT COMMERCIAL',
												'Direct Employee',
												'Direct Retail',
												'HCP - Employee',
												'HCP - Professional',
												'HCP - Retail',
												'HCP - E-TAILER'
												)

		AND [Ship To Customer Description] NOT LIKE '%Amazon%'
		AND [Ship To Customer Description] NOT LIKE '%Target%'
		AND [Ship To Customer Description] NOT LIKE '%WALMART%'

	GROUP BY
		 [Year Month]
		,ST.[State_Fullname]
		,[UPC]
		,[Material ID (JDE)]
		--,[Material Description]
),

ATRIUM_Direct_Shipments AS (

SELECT 
		 [Year Month] AS "Sale_Date"
		,ST.[State_Fullname] AS "STATE"
		,[UPC]
		,Null Source_UPC_Description
		,[Material ID (JDE)] AS MaterialKey
		,MAX([Material Description]) AS MaterialDesc
		,Null AS Dollar_Sales
		,SUM(ISNULL(CONVERT(FLOAT,[Sales Quantity]),0)) AS Unit_Sales
		,'ATRIUM Direct Shipments' AS "Source"

	FROM 
		[dr].[ERP_Atrium_Sales] Atr
	
	JOIN
		[dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON ST.[STATE]=[Ship To Customer State] AND ERP_Flag=1
	
	WHERE
			YEAR([Year Month])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)

	GROUP BY
		 [Year Month]
		,ST.[State_Fullname]
		,[UPC]
		,[Material ID (JDE)]
		--,[Material Description]
),

POS_Sales AS (
    SELECT 
		[Sale_Date],
		[State],
		[UPC] Matched_UPC,
		[UPC] Source_UPC,
		[Source_UPC_Description],
		[MaterialKey],
		[MaterialDesc],
		[Dollar_Sales],
		[Unit_Sales],
		[Source]
FROM 
		ATRIUM_POS

UNION ALL

SELECT 
		[Sale_Date],
		[State],
		[UPC] Matched_UPC,
		[UPC] Source_UPC,
		[Source_UPC_Description],
		[MaterialKey],
		[MaterialDesc],
		[Dollar_Sales],
		[Unit_Sales],
		[Source]
FROM
		ATRIUM_Direct_Shipments
)

INSERT INTO [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]

SELECT 
    pos.[Sale_Date],
    pos.[State],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(400), CASE WHEN pos.[Matched_UPC] = '' THEN NULL ELSE pos.[Matched_UPC] END) AS Matched_UPC,
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC_Description]) AS [Source_UPC_Description],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC]) AS Source_UPC,
    pos.[MaterialKey],
    pos.[Source],
    pos.[Dollar_Sales],
    pos.[Unit_Sales],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), CONCAT(
									B.[Bill Of Material], '-', 
									B.[MaterialKey], '-', 
									B.[Component], '-', 
									B.[Alternative BOM], '-', 
									b.state, '-', 
									b.[valid from], '-', 
									b.[Valid To], '-', 
									REPLACE(B.[Change No.], ' ', ''), '-', 
									[Item ID]
									)
			) AS "BOM KEY"
FROM 

    POS_Sales pos

LEFT JOIN 
			[dr].[BOM_CAA_Mapping] b ON pos.MaterialKey = b.MaterialKey 
										AND pos.State = b.State 
										AND b.[Valid To] >= pos.Sale_Date 
										AND b.[valid from] <= pos.Sale_Date

scripts.text:
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#VSap_Bom') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #VSap_Bom;

WITH MATERIAL_MASTER AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        LEFT(RIGHT([EANUPC], 11), 10) AS UPC,
        CASE 
            WHEN MaterialType IS NULL THEN 'NON SAP Brand'
            ELSE 'SAP Brand'
        END AS SAP_BRAND
    FROM 
        [dr].[dimCombinedMaterialHierarchy]
    WHERE 
        RIGHT(ISNULL(MaterialKey, ''), 4) <> '-ISC' 
        AND ISNULL(CrossPlantMaterialStatus, 'Null') IN (
            'Z3 Active',
            'Z2 Pre-Go Decision',
            'Z4 Under Discontinuation',
            'Null'
        )  
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel2BusinessDescription, '') <> 'US VMHS EXPORT'
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel3CategoryDescription, '') NOT IN ('US VMHS SOLGAR', 'US-ORGAIN')
),

SAP_Direct_Shipment AS (

				SELECT	[NHSC_SalesSummary].[CALDAY],
						CASE 
							WHEN 
								V.ProductLevel3CategoryID='US77L'
							THEN
								COALESCE(UMREN,1)*[NHSC_SalesSummary].[BaseUnit]
							ELSE 
								[NHSC_SalesSummary].[BaseUnit]
						END AS "BaseUnit",
						---VHMHS Brands
						CASE WHEN V.ProductLevel3CategoryID IN	('US77A','US00D','US008','US772','US009','US774','US77D',
									 'US775','US004','US001','US003','US005','US778','US00E','US446','US448',
									 'US00B','US777','US00C','US007','US006','US773','US77H','US77F',
									 'US77C','US77K','US77B','US002','US00A','USAA1','US77M','US776',
									 'US77E','US77G','US00F','US779','USAAE') --AND BILL_TYPE <> '#' 
									 AND CWWCCH IN ('12','17')
						THEN 
							ISNULL([GPS],0) - ISNULL([Trade_Asset_Revenue],0) + ISNULL([Surchgs_Lease_Oth],0)

						--ZENPEP & VIOKACE
						WHEN 
							V.ProductLevel3CategoryID IN ('US881','US882') AND ISNULL(LOC.[REGION],'') NOT IN ('') AND CWWCCH IN ('12','17')
						THEN 
							ISNULL([GPS],0) - ISNULL([Trade_Asset_Revenue],0) + ISNULL([Surchgs_Lease_Oth],0)
						
						---BOOST & Gut Health
						WHEN 
							V.ProductLevel3CategoryID IN ('US77L','US77J')
						THEN 
							ISNULL([GPS],0) - ISNULL([Trade_Asset_Revenue],0) + ISNULL([Surchgs_Lease_Oth],0)

						WHEN 
							V.ProductLevel3CategoryID IN ('USAAB') AND ISNULL(LOC.[REGION],'') NOT IN ('') AND CWWCCH NOT IN ('40','30')
						THEN 
							ISNULL([GPS],0)
							
						--WHEN US VITAL PROTEINS
						WHEN V.ProductLevel3CategoryID IN	('USAAA','USAAF') 
						     AND BILL_TYPE <> '#' 
							 AND CWWCCH NOT IN ('40','30') 
						THEN
							ISNULL([GPS],0) - ISNULL([Trade_Asset_Revenue],0) + ISNULL([Surchgs_Lease_Oth],0) 
						
						--WHEN NOT IN US VMHS AND US VITAL PROTEINS
						WHEN V.ProductLevel3CategoryID NOT IN	('US77A','US00D','US008','US772','US009','US774','US77D',
									 'US775','US004','US001','US003','US005','US778','US00E','US446','US448',
									 'US00B','US777','US00C','US007','US006','US773','US77H','US77F',
									 'US77C','US77K','US77B','US002','US00A','US77J','USAA1','US77L','US77M','US776',
									 'US77E','US77G','US00F','US779','USAAB','USAAE','USAAA','USAAF','US881','US882')
							 AND CWWCCH NOT IN ('40','30') 
						THEN
							ISNULL([GPS],0) - ISNULL([Trade_Asset_Revenue],0) + ISNULL([Surchgs_Lease_Oth],0) 
						
						ELSE 0 END "GPS_Cal",
						V.ProductLevel3CategoryID,
						v.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
						v.NHS_Group,
						MaterialDesc,
						V.UPC,
						V.[EANUPC] AS EANUPC,
						v.[MaterialKey],
						NHS
						--LOC.[NAME] AS SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER,
						--ST.[State_Fullname] AS "STATE"

				  FROM [dr].[NHSC_SalesSummary]
  
				  JOIN MATERIAL_MASTER v on v.[MaterialKey]=substring([MATERIAL], patindex('%[^0]%',[MATERIAL]), 10)
				  LEFT JOIN [dr].[NHSC_RPT_AMDR_V_MARM] IU ON substring(IU.MATNR, patindex('%[^0]%',IU.MATNR), 10)=substring([MATERIAL], patindex('%[^0]%',[MATERIAL]), 10) AND IU.MEINH='ZSG'
				  LEFT JOIN [dt].[BIG0CUSTOMER_V ] LOC ON CONVERT(NVARCHAR,CONVERT(BIGINT,LOC.[CUSTOMER]))=[SHIP_TO]
				  --LEFT JOIN [dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON ST.[STATE]=LOC.[REGION] AND [Type] in ('State','Federal District')
				  				  
				  WHERE 
						 --CUST_SALES_DESC not in ('VitalProteins.com','Nestle Australia Ltd.')
						--Excludes Affiliate Sales
							CWWCCH NOT IN ('40','30') 
						AND YEAR([CALDAY])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)
						AND ISNULL(MATERIAL_DESC,'NA') not  in('Dummy NUUN Energy','Dummy NUUN Immunity Other','Dummy NUUN Other','Dummy NUUN Performance','Dummy NUUN Rest Tubes','Dummy NUUN Sport','Dummy NUUN Vitamins Bags') 
						AND NHS IS NOT NULL
						--NOT IN US SOLGAR OR US GARDEN OF LIFE
						AND V.ProductLevel3CategoryID NOT IN ('USAAD','USAAE')
						
						
			),

Merged_SAP_Direct_Sales AS (

SELECT 

	   CONVERT(DATE,CONCAT(YEAR([CALDAY]),'-',MONTH([CALDAY]),'-01')) AS "Sale_Date"
	  ,[UPC]
	  ,LEFT(RIGHT([EANUPC],11),10) EANUPC
	  ,[MaterialDesc] Source_UPC_Description
	  ,MaterialKey AS MaterialKey
	  ,[MaterialDesc] AS MaterialDesc
      ,SUM(ISNULL([GPS_Cal],0)) AS Dollar_Sales
	  ,SUM(ISNULL([BaseUnit],0)) AS Unit_Sales
	  ,'SAP Direct Shipments' AS "Source"

FROM 
		SAP_Direct_Shipment
WHERE 
		--SUBSTRING(CUST_SALES, CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES, CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES) + 1) + 1, CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES, CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES, CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES) + 1) + 1) - CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES, CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES) + 1) - 1) in ( 'US01','US04')
		--WHEN US ALLERGY, US BOOST, US CBE, US COMPLEAT FAMILY, US DISEASE SPECIFIC, US DYSPHAGIA, US GI, US MN BOOST, US MODULARS, US OPTIFAST, US PEDIATRIC STANDARDS, US PEPTAMEN FAMILY, US STANDARD TUBE FEEDING, US VITAL PROTEINS, US VMHS CELLULAR NUTRITION, US VMHS GUT HEALTH, US VMHS NUUN
		ProductLevel3CategoryID IN	('USZZE','USAA1','USAA2','USZZC','USZZ1','USZZ4','USZZ2',
										 'USZZ7','USZZ5','USAA6','USZZG','USZZ3','USZZD','USZZ8','USAAA','USAAF',
										 'US77H','USAA8','US77J','US77K','US77M','USAAB')
		
GROUP BY 
		
		 CONVERT(DATE,CONCAT(YEAR([CALDAY]),'-',MONTH([CALDAY]),'-01'))
		,[EANUPC]
		,[UPC]
		,MaterialKey
		,[MaterialDesc]


UNION ALL

SELECT 
	   CONVERT(DATE,CONCAT(YEAR([CALDAY]),'-',MONTH([CALDAY]),'-01')) AS "Sales_Date"
	  ,[UPC]
	  ,[EANUPC]
	  ,[MaterialDesc] Source_UPC_Description
	  ,MaterialKey AS MaterialKey
	  ,[MaterialDesc] AS MaterialDesc
      ,SUM(ISNULL([GPS_Cal],0)) AS Dollar_Sales
	  ,SUM(ISNULL([BaseUnit],0)) AS Unit_Sales
	  ,'SAP Direct Shipments' AS "Source"

FROM 
		SAP_Direct_Shipment

WHERE
		--WHEN NOT US ALLERGY, US BOOST, US CBE, US COMPLEAT FAMILY, US DISEASE SPECIFIC, US DYSPHAGIA, US GI, US MN BOOST, US MODULARS, US OPTIFAST, US PEDIATRIC STANDARDS, US PEPTAMEN FAMILY, US STANDARD TUBE FEEDING, US VITAL PROTEINS, US VMHS CELLULAR NUTRITION, US VMHS GUT HEALTH, US VMHS NUUN
		  ProductLevel3CategoryID NOT IN	('USZZE','USAA1','USAA2','USZZC','USZZ1','USZZ4','USZZ2',
										 'USZZ7','USZZ5','USAA6','USZZG','USZZ3','USZZD','USZZ8','USAAA','USAAF',
										 'US77H','USAA8','US77J','US77K','US77M','USAAB')
GROUP BY

SAP_Direct_Sales_By_State AS (
    SELECT 
		[Sale_Date],
		ST.[State_Fullname] AS [State],
		[UPC] Matched_UPC,
		[EANUPC] Source_UPC,
		[Source_UPC_Description],
		[MaterialKey],
		[MaterialDesc],
		([Dollar_Sales]*[US_Per_Population]) AS [Dollar_Sales],
		([Unit_Sales]*[US_Per_Population]) AS [Unit_Sales],
		[Source]
FROM 
		Merged_SAP_Direct_Sales
JOIN
	 [dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON 1=1 AND ERP_Flag=1 AND [Type]='State'

)

SELECT 
    pos.[Sale_Date],
    pos.[State],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(400), CASE WHEN pos.[Matched_UPC] = '' THEN NULL ELSE pos.[Matched_UPC] END) AS Matched_UPC,
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC_Description]) AS [Source_UPC_Description],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC]) AS Source_UPC,
    pos.[MaterialKey],
    pos.[Source],
    pos.[Dollar_Sales],
    pos.[Unit_Sales],
	b.[BOMCategory],
	B.[Bill Of Material],
	B.[Alternative BOM],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), CONCAT(
									B.[Bill Of Material], '-', 
									B.[MaterialKey], '-', 
									B.[Component], '-', 
									B.[Alternative BOM], '-', 
									b.state, '-', 
									b.[valid from], '-', 
									b.[Valid To], '-', 
									REPLACE(B.[Change No.], ' ', ''), '-',
									REPLACE(B.[Change No. To], ' ', ''), '-',
									[Item ID]
									)
			) AS "BOM KEY"


INTO #VSap_Bom

FROM 

    SAP_Direct_Sales_By_State pos

LEFT JOIN 
			[dr].[BOM_CAA_Mapping] b ON pos.MaterialKey = b.MaterialKey 
										AND pos.State = b.State 
										AND b.[Valid To] >= pos.Sale_Date 
										AND b.[valid from] <= pos.Sale_Date;

DELETE
FROM 
	#VSap_Bom
WHERE
	isnull([Dollar_Sales],0)+isnull([Unit_Sales],0)=0;


IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#VSap_Bom_Final') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #VSap_Bom_Final;

SELECT

		 [Sale_Date]
		,[State]
		,[Matched_UPC]
		,[Source_UPC_Description]
		,[Source_UPC]
		,[MaterialKey]
		,[Source]
		,[Dollar_Sales]
		,[Unit_Sales]
		,[BOM KEY]

INTO #VSap_Bom_Final

FROM #VSap_Bom B

WHERE

COALESCE((	SELECT
				MAX(AlternativeBOM) LATEST  
		FROM
				dr.BOM_HEADER_VALIDITY V
		WHERE 

					V.[BillOfMaterial]=B.[Bill Of Material]
				AND V.[BOMCategory]=B.[BOMCategory]
				AND B.Sale_Date  BETWEEN V.[Valid-FromDate] AND V.[Valid To]
	),'<NA>')=B.[Alternative BOM];

INSERT INTO #VSap_Bom_Final

SELECT
		 B.[Sale_Date]
		,[State]
		,[Matched_UPC]
		,[Source_UPC_Description]
		,[Source_UPC]
		,B.[MaterialKey]
		,[Source]
		,[Dollar_Sales]
		,[Unit_Sales]
		,[BOM KEY]

FROM 
		#VSap_Bom B

LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT
					 [Sale_Date]
					,[MaterialKey]
			FROM
					#VSap_Bom_Final

			GROUP BY [Sale_Date]
					,[MaterialKey]
) S ON S.[Sale_Date]=B.[Sale_Date] AND S.[MaterialKey]=B.[MaterialKey]

WHERE S.[Sale_Date] IS NULL AND ISNULL([Alternative BOM],'<NA>') IN ('01','<NA>');

DELETE 
FROM [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]
WHERE [Source] IN ('SAP Direct Shipments');

		,[State]

		,[Source_UPC]
		,[MaterialKey]
		,[Source]
		,[Dollar_Sales]
		,[Unit_Sales]
		,[BOM KEY]

FROM 
		#VSap_Bom_Final;

DROP TABLE #VSap_Bom_Final;

WITH MATERIAL_MASTER AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        LEFT(RIGHT([EANUPC], 11), 10) AS UPC,
        CASE 
            WHEN MaterialType IS NULL THEN 'NON SAP Brand'
            ELSE 'SAP Brand'
        END AS SAP_BRAND
    FROM 
        [dr].[dimCombinedMaterialHierarchy]
    WHERE 
        RIGHT(ISNULL(MaterialKey, ''), 4) <> '-ISC' 
        AND ISNULL(CrossPlantMaterialStatus, 'Null') IN (
            'Z3 Active',
            'Z2 Pre-Go Decision',
            'Z4 Under Discontinuation',
            'Null'
        )  
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel2BusinessDescription, '') <> 'US VMHS EXPORT'
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel3CategoryDescription, '') NOT IN ('US VMHS SOLGAR', 'US-ORGAIN')
),

SAP_Direct_Shipment AS (

				SELECT [NHSC_SalesSummary].*
					  ,	CASE WHEN V.ProductLevel3CategoryID IN	('US77A','US00D','US008','US772','US009','US774','US77D',
									 'US775','US004','US001','US003','US005','US778','US00E','US446','US448',
									 'US00B','US777','US00C','US007','US006','US773','US77H','US77F',
									 'US77C','US77K','US77B','US002','US00A','US77J','USAA1','US77L','US77M','US776',
									 'US77E','US77G','US00F','US779','USAAB','USAAD','USAAE') AND BILL_TYPE <> '#'
						THEN 
							ISNULL([NPS],0) 
						
						--WHEN US VITAL PROTEINS
						WHEN V.ProductLevel3CategoryID IN	('USAAA','USAAF') AND BILL_TYPE <> '#' 
						
						THEN
							ISNULL([GPS],0) - ISNULL([Trade_Asset_Revenue],0) + ISNULL([Surchgs_Lease_Oth],0) 
						
						--WHEN NOT IN US VMHS AND US VITAL PROTEINS
						WHEN V.ProductLevel3CategoryID NOT IN	('US77A','US00D','US008','US772','US009','US774','US77D',
									 'US775','US004','US001','US003','US005','US778','US00E','US446','US448',
									 'US00B','US777','US00C','US007','US006','US773','US77H','US77F',
									 'US77C','US77K','US77B','US002','US00A','US77J','USAA1','US77L','US77M','US776',
									 'US77E','US77G','US00F','US779','USAAB','USAAD','USAAE','USAAA','USAAF')
						THEN
							ISNULL([GPS],0) - ISNULL([Trade_Asset_Revenue],0) + ISNULL([Surchgs_Lease_Oth],0) 
						
						ELSE 0 END "GPS_Cal",
						V.ProductLevel3CategoryID,
						v.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
						v.NHS_Group,
						MaterialDesc,
						V.UPC,
						V.[EANUPC] AS EANUPC,
						v.[MaterialKey],
						NHS
						--LOC.[NAME] AS SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER,
						--ST.[State_Fullname] AS "STATE"

				  FROM [dr].[NHSC_SalesSummary]
  
				  JOIN MATERIAL_MASTER v on v.[MaterialKey]=substring([MATERIAL], patindex('%[^0]%',[MATERIAL]), 10)
				  LEFT JOIN [dt].[BIG0CUSTOMER_V ] LOC ON CONVERT(NVARCHAR,CONVERT(BIGINT,LOC.[CUSTOMER]))=[SHIP_TO]
				  JOIN [dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON ST.[STATE]=LOC.[REGION] AND [Type] in ('State','Federal District')
				  				  
				  WHERE 
						 --CUST_SALES_DESC not in ('VitalProteins.com','Nestle Australia Ltd.')
						--Excludes Affiliate Sales
							YEAR([CALDAY])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)
						AND CWWCCH NOT IN ('40') 
						AND ISNULL(MATERIAL_DESC,'NA') not  in('Dummy NUUN Energy','Dummy NUUN Immunity Other','Dummy NUUN Other','Dummy NUUN Performance','Dummy NUUN Rest Tubes','Dummy NUUN Sport','Dummy NUUN Vitamins Bags') 
						AND NHS IS NOT NULL
			),

Merged_SAP_Direct_Sales AS (

SELECT

GROUP BY

scripts.text:
DELETE 
FROM [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]
WHERE [Source]='AMAZON DATA';


WITH AMAZON_UPC_DATA AS (
    SELECT
        AR.Date AS "Sale_Date",
        AR.[ASIN],
        AAM.[Product] AS "Source_UPC_Description",
        SUM(AR.[Shipped_Units]) AS "Unit_Sales",
        AR.State,
        CASE 
            WHEN AAM.UPC = 'UNKNOWN' AND AAM.EAN != 'UNKNOWN' THEN AAM.EAN 
            ELSE AAM.UPC 
        END AS UPC,
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN APC.ListPrice IS NOT NULL THEN (APC.ListPrice * AR.[Shipped_Units]) 
                ELSE (APC.AmazonLastPrice * AR.[Shipped_Units]) 
            END
        ) AS Dollar_Sales
    FROM 
        [dr].[ERP_Amazon_Sales_Report] AR
    
	LEFT JOIN (
					SELECT * 
					FROM (
						SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY [ASIN] ORDER BY [ASIN]) AS RN 
						FROM [dr].[ERP_Amazon_ASIN_Mapping]
					) SUB 
				) AAM ON AR.ASIN = AAM.ASIN AND AAM.RN = 1
    
	LEFT JOIN (
					SELECT * 
					FROM (
						SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY [ASIN] ORDER BY [ASIN]) AS RN 
						FROM [dr].[Amazon_dimProductCatalog] 
						WHERE CountryCode = 'US'
					) SUB 
				) APC ON AAM.ASIN = APC.ASIN AND APC.CountryCode = 'US' AND APC.RN = 1
    
	WHERE 
        
		AR.VC_account IN ('Garden of Life', 'NHS U.S., LLC', 'NPG Solgar', 'Orgain') 
    
	GROUP BY 
        AR.Date,
        AAM.[Product],
        AR.[ASIN],
        AR.[Shipped_Units],
        AR.State,
        CASE 
            WHEN AAM.UPC = 'UNKNOWN' AND AAM.EAN != 'UNKNOWN' THEN AAM.EAN 
            ELSE AAM.UPC 
        END
),

POS_Sales AS (
    SELECT
        AD.[Sale_Date] AS "Sale_Date",
        ST.[State_Fullname] AS [State],
        M.[UPC] AS Matched_UPC,
        AD.[ASIN] AS Source_UPC,
        AD.[Source_UPC_Description],
        M.MaterialKey AS MaterialKey,
        M.MaterialDesc AS MaterialDesc,
        SUM(AD.[Dollar_Sales]) AS Dollar_Sales,
        SUM(CONVERT(FLOAT, AD.[Unit_Sales])) AS Unit_Sales,
        'AMAZON DATA' AS "Source"
    FROM 
        AMAZON_UPC_DATA AD
    JOIN 
        [dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] ST ON ST.[State] = AD.[State] AND ST.[ERP_Flag] = 1
    LEFT JOIN 
        dr.ERP_UPC_Mapping M ON LEFT(RIGHT(AD.UPC, 11), 10) = M.UPC
    WHERE 
        YEAR(AD.[Sale_Date]) = (SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)
    GROUP BY 
        AD.[Sale_Date],
        ST.[State_Fullname],
        M.[UPC],
        AD.[ASIN],
        AD.[Source_UPC_Description],
        M.MaterialKey,
        M.MaterialDesc
)

INSERT INTO [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]

SELECT 
    pos.[Sale_Date],
    pos.[State],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(400), CASE WHEN pos.[Matched_UPC] = '' THEN NULL ELSE pos.[Matched_UPC] END) AS Matched_UPC,
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC_Description]) AS [Source_UPC_Description],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC]) AS Source_UPC,
    pos.[MaterialKey],
    pos.[Source],
    pos.[Dollar_Sales],
    pos.[Unit_Sales],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), CONCAT(
									B.[Bill Of Material], '-', 
									B.[MaterialKey], '-', 
									B.[Component], '-', 
									B.[Alternative BOM], '-', 
									b.state, '-', 
									b.[valid from], '-', 
									b.[Valid To], '-', 
									REPLACE(B.[Change No.], ' ', ''), '-',
									REPLACE(B.[Change No. To], ' ', ''), '-',
									[Item ID]
									)
			) AS "BOM KEY"
FROM 

    POS_Sales pos

LEFT JOIN 
			[dr].[BOM_CAA_Mapping] b ON pos.MaterialKey = b.MaterialKey 
										AND pos.State = b.State 
										AND b.[Valid To] >= pos.Sale_Date 
										AND b.[valid from] <= pos.Sale_Date

*/

/*new report
https://app.powerbi.com/groups/me/apps/389f4950-e776-4909-b6d0-d3d996918cc2/reports/f6826c39-f315-4623-a1cd-098a7bd37ca8/8a55c7cbe70a1be2ee15?experience=power-bi
*/


WITH
ALLDATA AS (SELECT WERKS Plant
                 , p.plant_description Plant_Descption
                 , p.plant_type_code AS PLANT_TYPE_CODE1
                 , bukrs Company_Code
                 , lgort Storage_Location
                 , (CASE
                         WHEN lgort = '0001' THEN 'Main Location'
                         ELSE 'Discrepancies'
                    END) Storage_Description
                 , REGEXP_REPLACE(v.MATNR, '^0+', '') Material
                 , md.maktx Material_Description
                 , charg Batch
                 , bwart Movement_Type
                 , (CASE
                         WHEN mt.txtmd IS NULL THEN bwart
                         ELSE mt.txtmd
                    END) Movement_Description
                 , GRUND Reason_Goods_MovmentID
                 , (CASE
                         WHEN m."Text: Reason for Goods Movement" IS NULL THEN CONCAT(bwart, '_Not Assigned')
                         ELSE m."Text: Reason for Goods Movement"
                    END) Reason_Goods_Movement_Description
                 , usnam_mkpf USERNAME
                 , mblnr Material_Doc_Number
                 , budat_mkpf Posting_Date
                 , mjahr Posting_Year
                 , CONCAT(WEEK(TO_DATE(budat_mkpf, 'yyyyMMdd')), '-', mjahr) Posting_Week_Year
                 , CONCAT(TO_VARCHAR(TO_DATE(budat_mkpf, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'MM'), '-', mjahr) Posting_Month_Year
                 , CONCAT(LEFT(cputm_mkpf, 2), ':', RIGHT(LEFT(cputm_mkpf, 4), 2), ':', RIGHT(cputm_mkpf, 2)) Time_Entry
                 , CONCAT(ROUND((CASE
                                      WHEN v.shkzg = 'H' THEN MENGE * -1
                                      ELSE MENGE * 1
                                 END), 2), ' ', MEINS) Qty_BUoM_Text
                 , ROUND((CASE
                               WHEN v.shkzg = 'H' THEN MENGE * -1
                               ELSE MENGE * 1
                          END), 2) Qty_BUoM
                 , ROUND((CASE
                               WHEN v.shkzg = 'H' THEN MENGE * -1
                               ELSE MENGE * 1
                          END) / COALESCE(NULLIF(uomcs.umrez, 0), 1), 0) Qty_CS
                 , ROUND((CASE
                               WHEN v.shkzg = 'H' THEN MENGE * -1
                               ELSE MENGE * 1
                          END) / COALESCE(NULLIF(uompal.umrez, 0), 1), 2) Qty_Pallets
                 , ROUND((CASE
                               WHEN v.shkzg = 'H' THEN dmbtr * -1
                               ELSE dmbtr * 1
                          END), 2) Qty_Value
                 , 'SF_Azure_Automation' Created_By
                 , TO_CHAR(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('America/New_York', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS') Last_Updated
                 ,*
              FROM EDW.PRS.S6_ERPAMS_MSEG_V v
             INNER JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."S6_MD_D_MATERIAL_V" v2
                     ON v.matnr = v2.material_code
              LEFT JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."BIG0MOVETYPE_V" mt
                     ON mt.MOVETYPE = bwart
              LEFT JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."CSP_RPT_MASTER_PLANT_V" p
                     ON p.plant_key = werks
              LEFT OUTER JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_MAKT_V" md
                           ON md.matnr = v.matnr
                          AND spras = 'E'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN "EDW"."PRSCS"."S6_SC_CS_REASONFORMOVEMENT_TEXT_V" m
                           ON m."Movement Type (Inventory Management)" = v.bwart
                          AND m."Reason for Movement" = grund
                          AND m."Language Key" = 'E'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_MARM_V" uompal
                           ON uompal.matnr = v.matnr
                          AND uompal.meinh = 'PAL'
              LEFT OUTER JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_MARM_V" uomcs
                           ON uomcs.matnr = v.matnr
                          AND uomcs.meinh = 'CS'
             WHERE mjahr = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE)
               AND v2.MATERIAL_TYPE_CODE IN ('FERT', 'HALB')
                   -- AND BUKRS IN ('US8X', 'US16')
               AND WERKS IN ('5019', '5023', '5081', '5083', '5363', '5378', '5549', '5581', '5585', '5732', '5739', '5754', '5787', '5872', '5873', '5886', '5891', '5986', 'U100', 'U101', 'U106', 'U107', 'U111', 'UM12', 'UM18', 'UM19', 'UM22', 'UM23', 'UM24', 'UM25', 'UM26', 'UM27', 'UM29', 'UM35', 'UM36', 'UM39', 'UM40', 'UM41', 'UM43') --, 'UM50', 'UM66')
                   --AND PAOBJNR <> 0
               AND LGORT IN ('0001', 'Z999')
               AND bwart NOT IN ('101', '102', '122', '161', '162', '201', '221', '222', '261', '262', '301', '309', '325', '326', '343', '344', '541', '542', '561', '562', '565', '566', '601', '602', '641', '642', '643', '647', '648', '653', '657', '658', 'Y31', 'Y32','YY1', 'Z11', 'Z19', 'Z57', 'Z58', 'Z65', 'ZA1', 'ZA3', 'ZB8', 'ZBA', 'ZCM', 'ZJ1', 'ZJ2', 'ZJ7', 'ZJS', 'ZJT', 'ZU2', 'ZY1', 'ZY2', 'ZY5', 'ZY6'))

                 , mblnr Material_Doc_Number
                 , budat_mkpf Posting_Date
                 , mjahr Posting_Year
                 , concat(WEEK(TO_DATE(budat_mkpf, 'yyyyMMdd')), '-', mjahr) Posting_Week_Year
                 , concat(TO_VARCHAR(TO_DATE(budat_mkpf, 'yyyyMMdd'), 'MM'), '-', mjahr) Posting_Month_Year
                 , concat(LEFT(cputm_mkpf, 2), ':', RIGHT(LEFT(cputm_mkpf, 4), 2), ':', RIGHT(cputm_mkpf, 2)) Time_Entry
                 , CONCAT(ROUND((CASE
                                      WHEN v.shkzg = 'H' THEN MENGE * -1

                 , ROUND((CASE
                               WHEN v.shkzg = 'H' THEN MENGE * -1
                               ELSE MENGE * 1

                               ELSE MENGE * 1
                          END) / COALESCE(NULLIF(uomcs.umrez, 0), 1), 0) Qty_CS

                               ELSE MENGE * 1

              LEFT OUTER JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."MDH_MARM_V" uompal

WITH  POS_Sales AS (
	 
SELECT [Date] AS "Sale_Date"
      ,ST.State_Fullname AS [State]

      ,C.[UPC] Source_UPC
      ,[Customer_Item_Description] Source_UPC_Description
	  ,M.MaterialKey AS MaterialKey

	  ,'COSTCO POS' AS "Source"
  FROM [dr].[ERP_Costco_POS] C

	JOIN

			dr.ERP_UPC_Mapping M ON M.[EANUPC]=C.[UPC]
	
	WHERE

			,M.MaterialDesc
			,M.[UPC]

SELECT 
    pos.[Sale_Date],
    pos.[State],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(400), CASE WHEN pos.[Matched_UPC] = '' THEN NULL ELSE pos.[Matched_UPC] END) AS Matched_UPC,

WITH MultipleLoads AS (
						SELECT  
								 [Creation_Date]
								,[Fiscal_Year]
								,RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY [Fiscal_Year] ORDER BY [Creation_Date] DESC) AS RN
						FROM 
								[dr].[ERP_Fees_CAA_Group]
						GROUP BY 
								[Fiscal_Year],[Creation_Date]
						)

DELETE 
		FEES
FROM 
		[dr].[ERP_Fees_CAA_Group] FEES
JOIN 
		MultipleLoads M ON M.[Creation_Date]=FEES.[Creation_Date] AND M.[Fiscal_Year]=FEES.[Fiscal_Year]
WHERE 
		M.RN>1

WITH CTE AS (
				SELECT
						 [FERT]
						,ISNULL([Non-Separable Mapping],'<NA>') AS "Non-Separable Mapping"
				FROM
						[dr].[ERP_NON-Separable]
				GROUP BY        
						 [FERT]
						,ISNULL([Non-Separable Mapping],'<NA>')
				HAVING COUNT(1)=1
  )

  
  DELETE M
 FROM [dr].[ERP_NON-Separable] M
 JOIN CTE S ON S.[FERT]=M.[FERT] AND S.[Non-Separable Mapping]=ISNULL(M.[Non-Separable Mapping],'<NA>')

scripts.text:
DELETE 
FROM [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]
WHERE [Source] IN ('GOL & SOLGAR Direct Sales');


WITH  MATERIAL_MASTER AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        LEFT(RIGHT([EANUPC], 11), 10) AS UPC,
        CASE 
            WHEN MaterialType IS NULL THEN 'NON SAP Brand'
            ELSE 'SAP Brand'
        END AS SAP_BRAND
    FROM 
        [dr].[dimCombinedMaterialHierarchy]
    WHERE 
        RIGHT(ISNULL(MaterialKey, ''), 4) <> '-ISC' 
        AND ISNULL(CrossPlantMaterialStatus, 'Null') IN (
            'Z3 Active',
            'Z2 Pre-Go Decision',
            'Z4 Under Discontinuation',
            'Null'
        )  
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel2BusinessDescription, '') <> 'US VMHS EXPORT'
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel3CategoryDescription, '') NOT IN ('US VMHS SOLGAR', 'US-ORGAIN')
),

GOL_Solgar_TOTAL_US AS (

SELECT 
		GOL.[Date] AS "Sale_Date",
		M.[UPC] AS Matched_UPC,
		M.[EANUPC] AS Source_UPC,
		GOL.[Item Name] AS Source_UPC_Description,
		GOL.[Item Number] AS MaterialKey,
		M.MaterialDesc,
		SUM(GOL.[GPS]) AS Dollar_Sales,
		SUM(GOL.[Quantity]) AS Unit_Sales,
		'GOL & SOLGAR Direct Sales' AS "Source"

  FROM [dr].[ERP_GOL_Solgar] GOL
  
  --latest file provided by Katie on 3/3/2025 only had 'US' not broken by state, therefor below join had to be removed.
  --JOIN
	--[dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON GOL.[State]=ST.[State] AND [Type]='State'

  LEFT JOIN 
			MATERIAL_MASTER M ON M.MATERIALID=GOL.[Item Number]

  WHERE

			YEAR(GOL.[Date])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)
		AND [Account Name] NOT IN ('Manual Upload- DSP Correction')
  
  GROUP BY

  		GOL.[Date],
		M.[UPC],
		M.[EANUPC],
		GOL.[Item Number],
		GOL.[Item Name],
		M.MaterialDesc
		
		),

GOL_Solgar_BY_STATE_POPULATION AS (
SELECT 
		 GOL.[Sale_Date]
		,ST.[State_Fullname] AS "State"
		,GOL.[Matched_UPC] 
		,GOL.[Source_UPC]
		,GOL.[Source_UPC_Description]
		,GOL.[MaterialKey]
		,GOL.[MaterialDesc]
		,(GOL.[Dollar_Sales]*[US_Per_Population]) AS [Dollar_Sales]
		,(GOL.[Unit_Sales]*[US_Per_Population]) AS [Unit_Sales]
		,GOL.[Source]
FROM
	GOL_Solgar_TOTAL_US GOL

JOIN
	[dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON 1=1 AND ERP_Flag=1 AND [Type]='State'
)

    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC]) AS Source_UPC,
    pos.[MaterialKey],
    pos.[Source],
    pos.[Dollar_Sales],
    pos.[Unit_Sales],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), CONCAT(
									B.[Bill Of Material], '-', 
									B.[MaterialKey], '-', 
									B.[Component], '-', 
									B.[Alternative BOM], '-', 
									b.state, '-', 
									b.[valid from], '-', 
									b.[Valid To], '-', 
									REPLACE(B.[Change No.], ' ', ''), '-',
									REPLACE(B.[Change No. To], ' ', ''), '-',
									[Item ID]

			) AS "BOM KEY"
FROM

LEFT JOIN

        [dr].[dimCombinedMaterialHierarchy]
    WHERE 
        RIGHT(ISNULL(MaterialKey, ''), 4) <> '-ISC' 
        AND ISNULL(CrossPlantMaterialStatus, 'Null') IN (
            'Z3 Active',
            'Z2 Pre-Go Decision',
            'Z4 Under Discontinuation',
            'Null'
        )  
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel2BusinessDescription, '') <> 'US VMHS EXPORT'
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel3CategoryDescription, '') NOT IN ('US VMHS SOLGAR', 'US-ORGAIN')
),

GOL_Solgar_TOTAL_US AS (

SELECT 
		GOL.[Date] AS "Sale_Date",
		M.[UPC] AS Matched_UPC,
		M.[EANUPC] AS Source_UPC,
		GOL.[Item Name] AS Source_UPC_Description,
		GOL.[Item Number] AS MaterialKey,
		M.MaterialDesc,
		SUM(GOL.[GPS]) AS Dollar_Sales,
		SUM(GOL.[Quantity]) AS Unit_Sales,
		'Manual Display Direct Sales' AS "Source"

  FROM [dr].[ERP_GOL_Solgar] GOL
  
  --latest file provided by Katie on 3/3/2025 only had 'US' not broken by state, therefor below join had to be removed.
  --JOIN
	--[dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON GOL.[State]=ST.[State] AND [Type]='State'

  LEFT JOIN 
			MATERIAL_MASTER M ON M.MATERIALID=GOL.[Item Number]

  WHERE

			YEAR(GOL.[Date])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)
		AND [Account Name] IN ('Manual Upload- DSP Correction')
  
  GROUP BY

  		GOL.[Date],
		M.[UPC],
		M.[EANUPC],
		GOL.[Item Number],
		GOL.[Item Name],
		M.MaterialDesc
		
		),

GOL_Solgar_BY_STATE_POPULATION AS (
SELECT 
		 GOL.[Sale_Date]
		,ST.[State_Fullname] AS "State"
		,GOL.[Matched_UPC] 
		,GOL.[Source_UPC]
		,GOL.[Source_UPC_Description]
		,GOL.[MaterialKey]
		,GOL.[MaterialDesc]
		,(GOL.[Dollar_Sales]*[US_Per_Population]) AS [Dollar_Sales]
		,(GOL.[Unit_Sales]*[US_Per_Population]) AS [Unit_Sales]
		,GOL.[Source]
FROM
	GOL_Solgar_TOTAL_US GOL

JOIN
	[dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON 1=1 AND ERP_Flag=1 AND [Type]='State'
)

SELECT 
    pos.[Sale_Date],
    pos.[State],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(400), CASE WHEN pos.[Matched_UPC] = '' THEN NULL ELSE pos.[Matched_UPC] END) AS Matched_UPC,
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC_Description]) AS [Source_UPC_Description],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC]) AS Source_UPC,
    pos.[MaterialKey],
    pos.[Source],
    pos.[Dollar_Sales],
    pos.[Unit_Sales],
	b.[BOMCategory],
	B.[Bill Of Material],
	B.[Alternative BOM],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), CONCAT(
									B.[Bill Of Material], '-', 
									B.[MaterialKey], '-', 
									B.[Component], '-', 
									B.[Alternative BOM], '-', 
									b.state, '-', 
									b.[valid from], '-', 
									b.[Valid To], '-', 
									REPLACE(B.[Change No.], ' ', ''), '-',
									REPLACE(B.[Change No. To], ' ', ''), '-',
									[Item ID]
									)
			) AS "BOM KEY"

INTO #VManualDisplay_Bom

FROM 

    GOL_Solgar_BY_STATE_POPULATION pos

LEFT JOIN 
			[dr].[BOM_CAA_Mapping] b ON pos.MaterialKey = b.MaterialKey 
										AND pos.State = b.State 
										AND b.[Valid To] >= pos.Sale_Date 
										AND b.[valid from] <= pos.Sale_Date;

DELETE
FROM 
	#VManualDisplay_Bom
WHERE
	isnull([Dollar_Sales],0)+isnull([Unit_Sales],0)=0;


IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#VManualDisplay_Bom_Final') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #VManualDisplay_Bom_Final;

SELECT

		 [Sale_Date]
		,[State]
		,[Matched_UPC]
		,[Source_UPC_Description]
		,[Source_UPC]
		,[MaterialKey]
		,[Source]
		,[Dollar_Sales]
		,[Unit_Sales]
		,[BOM KEY]

INTO #VManualDisplay_Bom_Final

FROM #VManualDisplay_Bom B

WHERE

COALESCE((	SELECT
				MAX(AlternativeBOM) LATEST  
		FROM
				dr.BOM_HEADER_VALIDITY V
		WHERE 

					V.[BillOfMaterial]=B.[Bill Of Material]
				AND V.[BOMCategory]=B.[BOMCategory]
				AND B.Sale_Date  BETWEEN V.[Valid-FromDate] AND V.[Valid To]
	),'<NA>')=B.[Alternative BOM];

INSERT INTO #VManualDisplay_Bom_Final

SELECT
		 B.[Sale_Date]
		,[State]
		,[Matched_UPC]
		,[Source_UPC_Description]
		,[Source_UPC]
		,B.[MaterialKey]
		,[Source]
		,[Dollar_Sales]
		,[Unit_Sales]
		,[BOM KEY]

FROM 
		#VManualDisplay_Bom B

LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT
					 [Sale_Date]
					,[MaterialKey]
			FROM
					#VManualDisplay_Bom_Final

			GROUP BY [Sale_Date]
					,[MaterialKey]
) S ON S.[Sale_Date]=B.[Sale_Date] AND S.[MaterialKey]=B.[MaterialKey]

WHERE S.[Sale_Date] IS NULL AND ISNULL([Alternative BOM],'<NA>') IN ('01','<NA>');

DELETE 
FROM [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]
WHERE [Source] IN ('Manual Display Direct Sales');

		,[Source_UPC]
		,[MaterialKey]
		,[Source]
		,[Dollar_Sales]
		,[Unit_Sales]
		,[BOM KEY]

FROM 
		#VManualDisplay_Bom_Final;

DROP TABLE #VManualDisplay_Bom;
DROP TABLE #VManualDisplay_Bom_Final;

scripts.text:
delete from dr.TradeSAPPostingsData
where cast([Posting Date] as date)>=cast(getdate()-10 as date)
and cast([Posting Date] as date) <=cast(getdate()+2 as date);

insert into dr.TradeSAPPostingsData
SELECT ct.[BillingDocumentNo]
      ,ct.[BillingType]
      ,ct.[BillingTypeDesc]
      ,cast(replace(ct.[BillingDate],'.','') as varchar) as [BillingDate]
      ,replace(c.Postingdate,'.','') as PostingDatecode
  ,substring(cast(replace(c.Postingdate,'.','') as varchar),5,8) as PostingYear
      ,substring(substring(cast(replace(c.Postingdate,'.','') as varchar),1,4),3,4) as PostingMonth
      ,substring(cast(replace(c.Postingdate,'.','') as varchar),1,2) as PostingDay
      ,convert(datetime,cast(c.Postingdate as varchar),104) as PostingDate
      ,bh.[CompanyCode]
      ,bh.[SalesOrg]
      ,bh.[DistributionChannel]
      ,bh.[PaymentMethod]
      ,bh.[CreatedBy]
      ,bh.[CreatedOn]
      ,bh.[ReferenceDocumentNo]
      ,bh.[PayerCustomer]
      ,bh.[SoldToCustomer]
      ,bh.[AssignmentNo]
      ,bh.[PONumber]
      ,ct.[GL_Account]
      ,ct.[GL_AccountDesc]
      ,ct.[GL_AccrualAccount]
      ,ct.[GL_AccrualAccountDesc]
      ,ct.[MaterialId]
      ,c.SalesCredit
       ,ct.[ConditionType]
	   ,case when CHARINDEX('|',bh.PONumber) > 1
	   then substring(bh.PONumber,1,CHARINDEX('|',bh.PONumber)-1) 
	  else BWIdentifier end as ShortCode,
	  case when CHARINDEX('|',bh.PONumber) > 1 
	  then LEFT(substring(substring(bh.PONumber,CHARINDEX('|',bh.PONumber) + 1,len(bh.PONumber)),1,
	  (case when (charindex('|',substring(bh.PONumber,CHARINDEX('|', bh.PONumber) + 1,len(bh.PONumber))))>1
then CHARINDEX('|',substring(bh.PONumber,CHARINDEX('|', bh.PONumber) + 1, len(bh.PONumber)))-1
else len(substring(bh.PONumber,CHARINDEX('|', bh.PONumber) + 1, len(bh.PONumber))) end)),3)
else NULL end as EventTypeId
,''  as EventType
,'' as EventTypeDesc
,case when ct.[BillingType] = 'ZGB4' and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG0A','ZG50','ZG52','ZG0Q','ZG48','ZG0Z','ZG55','ZG49','ZG44','ZG0Y','ZG46','ZG0B','ZG1Q','ZG0F','ZG1F','ZG1M','ZG0D','ZG1N','ZG1P','ZG1H','ZG1K','ZG1J')
then SUM(-1*ConditionTypeValue) else 0 end as AccrualAndReversal_TradeAllowance
,case when ct.[BillingType] = 'ZGB4' and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG47','ZG0P','ZG1E','ZG1B')
then SUM(-1*ConditionTypeValue) else 0 end as AccrualAndReversal_TradeExpense
,case when ct.[BillingType] = 'ZGB4' and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG22','ZG0E','ZG1A','ZG98')
then SUM(-1*ConditionTypeValue) else 0 end as AccrualAndReversal_NonTrade
,case when ct.[ConditionType] in ('X112', 'X208', 'X005' ,'X205')
then SUM(-1*ConditionTypeValue) else 0 end as Expense_OITrade
,case when ct.[ConditionType] in ('X027')
then SUM(-1*ConditionTypeValue) else 0 end as Expense_OINonTrade
,case when ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG03','ZG22','ZGPB')
then SUM(-1*ConditionTypeValue) else 0 end as Expense_NonTrade
,case when ct.[BillingType] <> 'ZGB4' and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG08','ZG0M','ZG0T','ZG11','ZG13','ZG14','ZG16','ZG17','ZG19','ZG41','ZG5C')

,case when ct.[BillingType] <> 'ZGB4' and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG0L','ZG93')
then SUM(-1*ConditionTypeValue) else 0 end as Expense_BB_TradeExpense
,case when ct.[BillingType] = 'ZGB4'  and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG0A','ZG50','ZG52','ZG0Q','ZG48','ZG0Z','ZG55','ZG49','ZG44','ZG0Y','ZG46','ZG0B','ZG1Q','ZG0F','ZG1F','ZG1M','ZG0D','ZG1N','ZG1P','ZG1H','ZG1K','ZG1J')

when ct.[BillingType] = 'ZGB4' and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG22','ZG0E','ZG1A','ZG98')
then 'AccrualAndReversal_NonTrade'
when ct.[ConditionType] in ('X112', 'X208', 'X005' ,'X205')
then 'OITrade'
when ct.[ConditionType] in ('X027')
then 'OINonTrade'
when ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG03','ZG22','ZGPB')
then 'NonTrade'
when ct.[BillingType] <> 'ZGB4' and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG08','ZG0M','ZG0T','ZG11','ZG13','ZG14','ZG16','ZG17','ZG19','ZG41','ZG5C')
then 'BB_TradeAllowance'
when ct.[BillingType] <> 'ZGB4' and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG0L','ZG93')
then'BB_TradeExpense' else null end as 'Expense_Category'  
        ,SUM(-1*ConditionTypeValue) as ConditionTypeValue
		,SYSTEM_USER AS [MODIFIEDBY]

FROM  dt.TradeSAPGLConditionType ct LEFT OUTER JOIN dt.TradeSAPBillingDocHeader bh ON bh.[BillingAccountNumber] = ct.[BillingDocumentNo]
      LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT BillingDocumentNo,PostingDate,MaterialId,SalesCredit FROM (

	  OVER(PARTITION BY BillingDocumentNo,MaterialId ORDER BY grossProceeds desc,PostingDate)

	  WHERE Ranks =1) c
on ct.[BillingDocumentNo] = c.[BillingDocumentNo]  and ct.MaterialID =  c.MaterialID
  GROUP BY ct.[BillingDocumentNo]
      ,ct.[BillingType]

  ,case when CHARINDEX('|',bh.PONumber) > 1 then substring(bh.PONumber, 1, CHARINDEX('|',bh.PONumber)-1) else BWIdentifier end
    ,case when CHARINDEX('|',bh.PONumber) > 1 then LEFT(substring( substring(bh.PONumber,CHARINDEX('|', bh.PONumber) + 1, len(bh.PONumber)),1,
	(case when (charindex('|',substring(bh.PONumber,CHARINDEX('|', bh.PONumber) + 1, len(bh.PONumber))))>1
	then CHARINDEX('|',substring(bh.PONumber,CHARINDEX('|', bh.PONumber) + 1, len(bh.PONumber)))-1 else
	len(substring(bh.PONumber,CHARINDEX('|', bh.PONumber) + 1, len(bh.PONumber))) end)),3) else NULL end,case when ct.[BillingType] = 'ZGB4'  and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG0A','ZG50','ZG52','ZG0Q','ZG48','ZG0Z','ZG55','ZG49','ZG44','ZG0Y','ZG46','ZG0B','ZG1Q','ZG0F','ZG1F','ZG1M','ZG0D','ZG1N','ZG1P','ZG1H','ZG1K','ZG1J')
then 'AccrualAndReversal_TradeAllowance'
when ct.[BillingType] = 'ZGB4'  and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG47','ZG0P','ZG1E','ZG1B')
then 'AccrualAndReversal_TradeExpense'
when ct.[BillingType] = 'ZGB4' and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG22','ZG0E','ZG1A','ZG98')
then 'AccrualAndReversal_NonTrade'
when ct.[ConditionType] in ('X112', 'X208', 'X005' ,'X205')
then 'OITrade'
when ct.[ConditionType] in ('X027')
then 'OINonTrade'
when ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG03','ZG22','ZGPB')
then 'NonTrade'
when ct.[BillingType] <> 'ZGB4' and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG08','ZG0M','ZG0T','ZG11','ZG13','ZG14','ZG16','ZG17','ZG19','ZG41','ZG5C')
then 'BB_TradeAllowance'
when ct.[BillingType] <> 'ZGB4' and ct.[ConditionType] in ('ZG0L','ZG93')
then'BB_TradeExpense' else null end
      ,c.SalesCredit
      ,replace(PostingDate,'.','')
      ,substring(cast(replace(c.Postingdate,'.','') as varchar),5,8) 
      ,substring(substring(cast(replace(c.Postingdate,'.','') as varchar),1,4),3,4)

UPDATE dr.TradeSAPPostingsData

  [Event Type] = ev.EventTypeCode,
  [Event Type Description] = ev.EventTypeDescription,
  [Modified Date]=GETDATE()

WHERE dr.TradeSAPPostingsData.[Event Type ID] = ev.EventTypeID
and cast(dr.TradeSAPPostingsData.[Posting Date] as date)>=cast(getdate()-10 as date)

SET
   [Event Type] = ev.[ActivityCode],
   [Event Type Description]  = ev.[Activity],

FROM (
Select [ShortCode] ,[Activity] ,[ActivityCode] from ( SELECT [ShortCode] ,

activities.name: Populate POS Table with Atrium Direct Shipment

scripts.text:
DELETE 
FROM [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]
WHERE [Source] IN ('ATRIUM Direct Shipments');

WITH ATRIUM_TOTAL_US AS (

SELECT 
		 [Year Month] AS "Sale_Date"
		,[UPC]
		,Null Source_UPC_Description
		,[Material ID (JDE)] AS MaterialKey
		,MAX([Material Description]) AS MaterialDesc
		,SUM(ISNULL(CONVERT(FLOAT,[Gross Sales ($)]),0)) AS Dollar_Sales
		,SUM(ISNULL(CONVERT(FLOAT,[Sales Quantity]),0)) AS Unit_Sales
		,'ATRIUM Direct Shipments' AS "Source"

	FROM 
		[dr].[ERP_Atrium_Sales] Atr

	WHERE
			YEAR([Year Month])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)

	GROUP BY
		 [Year Month]
		,[UPC]
		,[Material ID (JDE)]

),

ATRIUM_BY_STATE_POPULATION AS (
SELECT 
		 A.[Sale_Date]
		,ST.[State_Fullname] AS "State"
		,A.[UPC] 
		,A.[Source_UPC_Description]
		,A.[MaterialKey]
		,A.[MaterialDesc]
		,(A.[Dollar_Sales]*[US_Per_Population]) AS [Dollar_Sales]
		,(A.[Unit_Sales]*[US_Per_Population]) AS [Unit_Sales]
		,A.[Source]
FROM
	ATRIUM_TOTAL_US A

JOIN
	[dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON 1=1 AND ERP_Flag=1 AND [Type]='State'
),

POS_Sales AS (
    SELECT 
		[Sale_Date],
		[State],
		[UPC] Matched_UPC,
		[UPC] Source_UPC,
		[Source_UPC_Description],
		[MaterialKey],
		[MaterialDesc],
		[Dollar_Sales],
		[Unit_Sales],
		[Source]
FROM 
		ATRIUM_BY_STATE_POPULATION
)

INSERT INTO [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]

SELECT 
    pos.[Sale_Date],
    pos.[State],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(400), CASE WHEN pos.[Matched_UPC] = '' THEN NULL ELSE pos.[Matched_UPC] END) AS Matched_UPC,
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC_Description]) AS [Source_UPC_Description],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC]) AS Source_UPC,
    pos.[MaterialKey],
    pos.[Source],
    pos.[Dollar_Sales],
    pos.[Unit_Sales],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), CONCAT(
									B.[Bill Of Material], '-', 
									B.[MaterialKey], '-', 
									B.[Component], '-', 
									B.[Alternative BOM], '-', 
									b.state, '-', 
									b.[valid from], '-', 
									b.[Valid To], '-', 
									REPLACE(B.[Change No.], ' ', ''), '-',
									REPLACE(B.[Change No. To], ' ', ''), '-',
									[Item ID]
									)
			) AS "BOM KEY"
FROM 

    POS_Sales pos

LEFT JOIN 
			[dr].[BOM_CAA_Mapping] b ON pos.MaterialKey = b.MaterialKey 
										AND pos.State = b.State 
										AND b.[Valid To] >= pos.Sale_Date 
										AND b.[valid from] <= pos.Sale_Date

scripts.text:
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#VSap_Bom') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #VSap_Bom;

WITH MATERIAL_MASTER AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        LEFT(RIGHT([EANUPC], 11), 10) AS UPC,
        CASE 
            WHEN MaterialType IS NULL THEN 'NON SAP Brand'
            ELSE 'SAP Brand'
        END AS SAP_BRAND
    FROM 
        [dr].[dimCombinedMaterialHierarchy]
    WHERE 
        RIGHT(ISNULL(MaterialKey, ''), 4) <> '-ISC' 
        AND ISNULL(CrossPlantMaterialStatus, 'Null') IN (
            'Z3 Active',
            'Z2 Pre-Go Decision',
            'Z4 Under Discontinuation',
            'Null'
        )  
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel2BusinessDescription, '') <> 'US VMHS EXPORT'
        AND ISNULL(ProductLevel3CategoryDescription, '') NOT IN ('US VMHS SOLGAR', 'US-ORGAIN')
),

SAP_Direct_Shipment AS (

				SELECT	[NHSC_SalesSummary].[CALDAY],
						CASE 
							WHEN 
								V.ProductLevel3CategoryID='US77L'
							THEN
								COALESCE(UMREN,1)*[NHSC_SalesSummary].[BaseUnit]
							ELSE 
								[NHSC_SalesSummary].[BaseUnit]
						END AS "BaseUnit",
						---VHMHS Brands
						CASE WHEN V.ProductLevel3CategoryID IN	('US77A','US00D','US008','US772','US009','US774','US77D',
									 'US775','US004','US001','US003','US005','US778','US00E','US446','US448',
									 'US00B','US777','US00C','US007','US006','US773','US77H','US77F',
									 'US77C','US77K','US77B','US002','US00A','USAA1','US77M','US776',
									 'US77E','US77G','US00F','US779','USAAE') --AND BILL_TYPE <> '#' 
									 AND CWWCCH IN ('12','17')
						THEN 
							ISNULL([GPS],0) - ISNULL([Trade_Asset_Revenue],0) + ISNULL([Surchgs_Lease_Oth],0)

						--ZENPEP & VIOKACE
						WHEN 
							V.ProductLevel3CategoryID IN ('US881','US882') AND ISNULL(LOC.[REGION],'') NOT IN ('') AND CWWCCH IN ('12','17')
						THEN 
							ISNULL([GPS],0) - ISNULL([Trade_Asset_Revenue],0) + ISNULL([Surchgs_Lease_Oth],0)
						
						---BOOST & Gut Health
						WHEN 
							V.ProductLevel3CategoryID IN ('US77L','US77J')
						THEN 
							ISNULL([GPS],0) - ISNULL([Trade_Asset_Revenue],0) + ISNULL([Surchgs_Lease_Oth],0)

						WHEN 
							V.ProductLevel3CategoryID IN ('USAAB') AND ISNULL(LOC.[REGION],'') NOT IN ('') AND CWWCCH NOT IN ('40','30')
						THEN 
							ISNULL([GPS],0)
							
						--WHEN US VITAL PROTEINS
						WHEN V.ProductLevel3CategoryID IN	('USAAA','USAAF') 
						     AND BILL_TYPE <> '#' 
							 AND CWWCCH NOT IN ('40','30') 
						THEN
							ISNULL([GPS],0) - ISNULL([Trade_Asset_Revenue],0) + ISNULL([Surchgs_Lease_Oth],0) 
						
						--WHEN NOT IN US VMHS AND US VITAL PROTEINS
						WHEN V.ProductLevel3CategoryID NOT IN	('US77A','US00D','US008','US772','US009','US774','US77D',
									 'US775','US004','US001','US003','US005','US778','US00E','US446','US448',
									 'US00B','US777','US00C','US007','US006','US773','US77H','US77F',
									 'US77C','US77K','US77B','US002','US00A','US77J','USAA1','US77L','US77M','US776',
									 'US77E','US77G','US00F','US779','USAAB','USAAE','USAAA','USAAF','US881','US882')
							 AND CWWCCH NOT IN ('40','30') 
						THEN
							ISNULL([GPS],0) - ISNULL([Trade_Asset_Revenue],0) + ISNULL([Surchgs_Lease_Oth],0) 
						
						ELSE 0 END "GPS_Cal",
						V.ProductLevel3CategoryID,
						v.ProductLevel3CategoryDescription,
						v.NHS_Group,
						MaterialDesc,
						V.UPC,
						V.[EANUPC] AS EANUPC,
						v.[MaterialKey],
						NHS
						--LOC.[NAME] AS SHIP_TO_CUSTOMER,
						--ST.[State_Fullname] AS "STATE"

				  FROM [dr].[NHSC_SalesSummary]
  
				  JOIN MATERIAL_MASTER v on v.[MaterialKey]=substring([MATERIAL], patindex('%[^0]%',[MATERIAL]), 10)
				  LEFT JOIN [dr].[NHSC_RPT_AMDR_V_MARM] IU ON substring(IU.MATNR, patindex('%[^0]%',IU.MATNR), 10)=substring([MATERIAL], patindex('%[^0]%',[MATERIAL]), 10) AND IU.MEINH='ZSG'
				  LEFT JOIN [dt].[BIG0CUSTOMER_V ] LOC ON CONVERT(NVARCHAR,CONVERT(BIGINT,LOC.[CUSTOMER]))=[SHIP_TO]
				  --LEFT JOIN [dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON ST.[STATE]=LOC.[REGION] AND [Type] in ('State','Federal District')
				  				  
				  WHERE 
						 --CUST_SALES_DESC not in ('VitalProteins.com','Nestle Australia Ltd.')
						--Excludes Affiliate Sales
							CWWCCH NOT IN ('40','30') 
						AND YEAR([CALDAY])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)
						AND ISNULL(MATERIAL_DESC,'NA') not  in('Dummy NUUN Energy','Dummy NUUN Immunity Other','Dummy NUUN Other','Dummy NUUN Performance','Dummy NUUN Rest Tubes','Dummy NUUN Sport','Dummy NUUN Vitamins Bags') 
						AND NHS IS NOT NULL
						--NOT IN US SOLGAR OR US GARDEN OF LIFE
						AND V.ProductLevel3CategoryID NOT IN ('USAAD','USAAE')
						
						
			),

Merged_SAP_Direct_Sales AS (

SELECT 

	   CONVERT(DATE,CONCAT(YEAR([CALDAY]),'-',MONTH([CALDAY]),'-01')) AS "Sale_Date"
	  ,[UPC]
	  ,LEFT(RIGHT([EANUPC],11),10) EANUPC
	  ,[MaterialDesc] Source_UPC_Description
	  ,MaterialKey AS MaterialKey
	  ,[MaterialDesc] AS MaterialDesc
      ,SUM(ISNULL([GPS_Cal],0)) AS Dollar_Sales
	  ,SUM(ISNULL([BaseUnit],0)) AS Unit_Sales
	  ,'SAP Direct Shipments' AS "Source"

FROM 
		SAP_Direct_Shipment
WHERE 
		--SUBSTRING(CUST_SALES, CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES, CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES) + 1) + 1, CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES, CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES, CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES) + 1) + 1) - CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES, CHARINDEX('/', CUST_SALES) + 1) - 1) in ( 'US01','US04')
		--WHEN US ALLERGY, US BOOST, US CBE, US COMPLEAT FAMILY, US DISEASE SPECIFIC, US DYSPHAGIA, US GI, US MN BOOST, US MODULARS, US OPTIFAST, US PEDIATRIC STANDARDS, US PEPTAMEN FAMILY, US STANDARD TUBE FEEDING, US VITAL PROTEINS, US VMHS CELLULAR NUTRITION, US VMHS GUT HEALTH, US VMHS NUUN
		ProductLevel3CategoryID IN	('USZZE','USAA1','USAA2','USZZC','USZZ1','USZZ4','USZZ2',
										 'USZZ7','USZZ5','USAA6','USZZG','USZZ3','USZZD','USZZ8','USAAA','USAAF',
										 'US77H','USAA8','US77J','US77K','US77M','USAAB')
		
GROUP BY 
		
		 CONVERT(DATE,CONCAT(YEAR([CALDAY]),'-',MONTH([CALDAY]),'-01'))
		,[EANUPC]
		,[UPC]
		,MaterialKey
		,[MaterialDesc]


UNION ALL

SELECT 
	   CONVERT(DATE,CONCAT(YEAR([CALDAY]),'-',MONTH([CALDAY]),'-01')) AS "Sales_Date"
	  ,[UPC]
	  ,[EANUPC]
	  ,[MaterialDesc] Source_UPC_Description
	  ,MaterialKey AS MaterialKey
	  ,[MaterialDesc] AS MaterialDesc
      ,SUM(ISNULL([GPS_Cal],0)) AS Dollar_Sales
	  ,SUM(ISNULL([BaseUnit],0)) AS Unit_Sales
	  ,'SAP Direct Shipments' AS "Source"

FROM 
		SAP_Direct_Shipment

WHERE
		--WHEN NOT US ALLERGY, US BOOST, US CBE, US COMPLEAT FAMILY, US DISEASE SPECIFIC, US DYSPHAGIA, US GI, US MN BOOST, US MODULARS, US OPTIFAST, US PEDIATRIC STANDARDS, US PEPTAMEN FAMILY, US STANDARD TUBE FEEDING, US VITAL PROTEINS, US VMHS CELLULAR NUTRITION, US VMHS GUT HEALTH, US VMHS NUUN
		  ProductLevel3CategoryID NOT IN	('USZZE','USAA1','USAA2','USZZC','USZZ1','USZZ4','USZZ2',
										 'USZZ7','USZZ5','USAA6','USZZG','USZZ3','USZZD','USZZ8','USAAA','USAAF',
										 'US77H','USAA8','US77J','US77K','US77M','USAAB')
GROUP BY 
 
		 CONVERT(DATE,CONCAT(YEAR([CALDAY]),'-',MONTH([CALDAY]),'-01'))
		,[UPC]
		,[EANUPC]
		,MaterialKey
		,[MaterialDesc]

),

SAP_Direct_Sales_By_State AS (
    SELECT 
		[Sale_Date],
		ST.[State_Fullname] AS [State],
		[UPC] Matched_UPC,
		[EANUPC] Source_UPC,
		[Source_UPC_Description],
		[MaterialKey],
		[MaterialDesc],
		([Dollar_Sales]*[US_Per_Population]) AS [Dollar_Sales],
		([Unit_Sales]*[US_Per_Population]) AS [Unit_Sales],
		[Source]
FROM 
		Merged_SAP_Direct_Sales
JOIN
	 [dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON 1=1 AND ERP_Flag=1 AND [Type]='State'

)

SELECT 
    pos.[Sale_Date],
    pos.[State],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(400), CASE WHEN pos.[Matched_UPC] = '' THEN NULL ELSE pos.[Matched_UPC] END) AS Matched_UPC,
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC_Description]) AS [Source_UPC_Description],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC]) AS Source_UPC,
    pos.[MaterialKey],
    pos.[Source],
    pos.[Dollar_Sales],
    pos.[Unit_Sales],
	b.[BOMCategory],
	B.[Bill Of Material],
	B.[Alternative BOM],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), CONCAT(
									B.[Bill Of Material], '-', 
									B.[MaterialKey], '-', 
									B.[Component], '-', 
									B.[Alternative BOM], '-', 
									b.state, '-', 
									b.[valid from], '-', 
									b.[Valid To], '-', 
									REPLACE(B.[Change No.], ' ', ''), '-',
									REPLACE(B.[Change No. To], ' ', ''), '-',
									[Item ID]
									)
			) AS "BOM KEY"


INTO #VSap_Bom

FROM 

    SAP_Direct_Sales_By_State pos

LEFT JOIN 
			[dr].[BOM_CAA_Mapping] b ON pos.MaterialKey = b.MaterialKey 
										AND pos.State = b.State 
										AND b.[Valid To] >= pos.Sale_Date 
										AND b.[valid from] <= pos.Sale_Date;

DELETE
FROM 
	#VSap_Bom
WHERE
	isnull([Dollar_Sales],0)+isnull([Unit_Sales],0)=0;


IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#VSap_Bom_Final') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #VSap_Bom_Final;

SELECT

		 [Sale_Date]
		,[State]
		,[Matched_UPC]
		,[Source_UPC_Description]
		,[Source_UPC]
		,[MaterialKey]
		,[Source]
		,[Dollar_Sales]
		,[Unit_Sales]
		,[BOM KEY]

INTO #VSap_Bom_Final

FROM #VSap_Bom B

WHERE

COALESCE((	SELECT
				MAX(AlternativeBOM) LATEST  
		FROM
				dr.BOM_HEADER_VALIDITY V
		WHERE 

					V.[BillOfMaterial]=B.[Bill Of Material]
				AND V.[BOMCategory]=B.[BOMCategory]
				AND B.Sale_Date  BETWEEN V.[Valid-FromDate] AND V.[Valid To]
	),'<NA>')=B.[Alternative BOM];

INSERT INTO #VSap_Bom_Final

SELECT
		 B.[Sale_Date]
		,[State]
		,[Matched_UPC]
		,[Source_UPC_Description]
		,[Source_UPC]
		,B.[MaterialKey]
		,[Source]
		,[Dollar_Sales]
		,[Unit_Sales]
		,[BOM KEY]

FROM 
		#VSap_Bom B

LEFT JOIN (
			SELECT
					 [Sale_Date]
					,[MaterialKey]
			FROM
					#VSap_Bom_Final

			GROUP BY [Sale_Date]
					,[MaterialKey]
) S ON S.[Sale_Date]=B.[Sale_Date] AND S.[MaterialKey]=B.[MaterialKey]

WHERE S.[Sale_Date] IS NULL AND ISNULL([Alternative BOM],'<NA>') IN ('01','<NA>');

DELETE 
FROM [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]
WHERE [Source] IN ('SAP Direct Shipments');

INSERT INTO [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]

SELECT
		 [Sale_Date]
		,[State]
		,[Matched_UPC]
		,[Source_UPC_Description]
		,[Source_UPC]
		,[MaterialKey]
		,[Source]
		,[Dollar_Sales]
		,[Unit_Sales]
		,[BOM KEY]

FROM 
		#VSap_Bom_Final;

DROP TABLE #VSap_Bom;
DROP TABLE #VSap_Bom_Final;

FROM [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]
WHERE [Source] IN ('Persona Direct Sales');

WITH Persona_TOTAL_US AS (

SELECT 
		[Date] AS "Sale_Date",
		'Persona' AS Matched_UPC,
		'Persona' AS Source_UPC,
		[SKU Desc] AS Source_UPC_Description,
		[SKU] AS MaterialKey,
		[SKU Desc] AS MaterialDesc,
		SUM([Estimated Units]) AS [Unit_Sales],
        SUM([GPS]) AS Dollar_Sales,
		'Persona Direct Sales' AS "Source"
  FROM [dr].[ERP_Persona] P

  WHERE

		YEAR(P.[Date])=(SELECT Reporting_Year FROM dr.ERP_Reporting_Year)
  
  GROUP BY

  		P.[Date],
		P.[SKU Desc],
		P.[SKU]
		),

Persona_BY_STATE_POPULATION AS (
SELECT 
		 P.[Sale_Date]
		,ST.[State_Fullname] AS "State"
		,P.[Matched_UPC] 
		,P.[Source_UPC]
		,P.[Source_UPC_Description]
		,P.[MaterialKey]
		,P.[MaterialDesc]
		,(P.[Dollar_Sales]*[US_Per_Population]) AS [Dollar_Sales]
		,(P.[Unit_Sales]*[US_Per_Population]) AS [Unit_Sales]
		,P.[Source]
FROM
	Persona_TOTAL_US P

JOIN
	[dr].[ERP_State_Mapping] AS ST ON 1=1 AND ERP_Flag=1 AND [Type]='State'
)

INSERT INTO [dr].[ERP_Consolidated_POS]

SELECT 
    pos.[Sale_Date],
    pos.[State],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(400), CASE WHEN pos.[Matched_UPC] = '' THEN NULL ELSE pos.[Matched_UPC] END) AS Matched_UPC,
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC_Description]) AS [Source_UPC_Description],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), pos.[Source_UPC]) AS Source_UPC,
    pos.[MaterialKey],
    pos.[Source],
    pos.[Dollar_Sales],
    pos.[Unit_Sales],
    CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4000), CONCAT(
									B.[Bill Of Material], '-', 
									B.[MaterialKey], '-', 
									B.[Component], '-', 
									B.[Alternative BOM], '-', 
									b.state, '-', 
									b.[valid from], '-', 
									b.[Valid To], '-', 
									REPLACE(B.[Change No.], ' ', ''), '-',
									REPLACE(B.[Change No. To], ' ', ''), '-',
									[Item ID]
									)
			) AS "BOM KEY"
FROM 

    Persona_BY_STATE_POPULATION pos

LEFT JOIN 
			[dr].[BOM_CAA_Mapping] b ON pos.MaterialKey = b.MaterialKey 
										AND pos.State = b.State 
										AND b.[Valid To] >= pos.Sale_Date 
										AND b.[valid from] <= pos.Sale_Date

WITH DEDUP(MANDT,EBELN,EBELP,AEDAT) AS
(select MANDT,EBELN,EBELP,MIN(AEDAT) AEDAT from [dr].[NHSC_3PL_Inbound_EKPO] EKPO
WHERE ISNULL(IS_DELETED,'N')='N'
group by MANDT,EBELN,EBELP
having count(*) > 1)
UPDATE [dr].[NHSC_3PL_Inbound_EKPO]
set IS_DELETED='Y'
FROM [dr].[NHSC_3PL_Inbound_EKPO] N1  JOIN
DEDUP ON (N1.MANDT=DEDUP.MANDT
and N1.EBELN=DEDUP.EBELN
and N1.EBELP=DEDUP.EBELP
and N1.AEDAT=DEDUP.AEDAT);

truncate table dr.F_Open_PurchaseOrders_StockTransferOrders;

insert into  dr.F_Open_PurchaseOrders_StockTransferOrders
SELECT EKPO.EBELN  as 
PurchaseOrderNumber,right(EKPO.MATNR,8) as MaterialID,
EKET.MENGE as Quantity,
cast(EINDT as datetime) AS ReceiptDate,
cast(WADAT as datetime) as ShippingDate,
EKPO.WERKS as DestinationLocationID,
(case when ISNULL(EKKO.RESWK,'')='' then EKKO.LIFNR ELSE
EKKO.RESWK END) as OriginLocationID,
(case when ISNULL(EKKO.RESWK,'')='' then  '2'
WHEN ISNULL(EKKO.RESWK,'')<> '' and cast(WADAT as date) <getdate() then '3'
else '1' end) OrderStatusID,
(case when ISNULL(EKKO.RESWK,'')='' then  'PO INBOUND'
WHEN ISNULL(EKKO.RESWK,'')<> '' and cast(WADAT as date) is not null
and cast(WADAT as date) <cast(getdate() as date) then 'SHIPPED, NOT RECEIVED'
else 'ON HAND NOT SHIPPED' end) OrderStatusDescription,
cast(getdate() as datetime) as ModifiedDate,
'nhscsqladmin' as ModifiedBy,
cast(getdate() as datetime) as SnapshotDate,
'Y' as ActiveFlag,
cast(EKKO.AEDAT as date) as STOCreationDate,
EKPO.EBELP as PurchaseOrderLine,
EKPO.LABNR as DeliveryNote,
'ASN-'+EKPO.LABNR AS ShipmentID,
EKKO.GLB_GRP_IND AS FreightOrderID
FROM [dr].[NHSC_3PL_Inbound_EKET] EKET,
dr.[NHSC_3PL_Inbound_EKPO] EKPO,
[dr].[NHSC_3PL_Inbound_EKKO] EKKO
WHERE  EKET.EBELN = EKPO.EBELN
AND EKET.EBELP = EKPO.EBELP
and EKPO.EBELN=EKKO.EBELN
AND ISNULL(EKPO.LOEKZ,'N') <>'L'
AND ISNULL(EKPO.ELIKZ,'N') <> 'X'
and ISNULL(EKPO.IS_DELETED,'N')='N'
and ISNULL(EKET.IS_DELETED,'N')='N'
and ISNULL(EKKO.IS_DELETED,'N')='N'
and EKPO.MTART in ('FERT','HALB')
--and cast(EINDT as date)<cast(getdate() as date)
and cast(EINDT as date)>=cast(getdate()-365 as date) ;

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT 
    p.SellingUPC,
    t.SalesOrgCode,
    t.TotalVolume,
    t.Scenariocode,
    t.PlanningCustomer,
	case when t.TimeKey like '%NHS-US%'  then SUBSTRING(t.TimeKey, 7, 4)
	     when t.TimeKey  like '%NN-NHS%'  then SUBSTRING(t.TimeKey, 7, 4)
			else SUBSTRING(t.TimeKey, 5, 4) end AS Year, 
	case when t.TimeKey like '%NHS-US%'  then SUBSTRING(t.TimeKey, 11, 2)
		when t.TimeKey like '%NN-NHS%' then SUBSTRING(t.TimeKey, 11, 2)
			else SUBSTRING(t.TimeKey, 11, 2) end AS Month, 

   CASE 
     when t.TimeKey like '%-%' then DATEPART(WEEK,CAST(SUBSTRING(t.TimeKey,7,8) AS DATE))
	 else  DATEPART(WEEK, CAST(SUBSTRING(t.TimeKey, 5, 8) AS DATE))  end as week, 
    t.UBP,
    t.NPS,
    t.BaselineVolume,
    t.UpliftVolume,
    t.GPS,
    t.TimeKey,
    p.productcode
FROM 
    NESTLETPMOUT.TotalSales t
LEFT OUTER JOIN 
    NESTLETPMOUT.Products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
where t.SalesOrgCode in ('NHS-US', 'NN-NHS')

source.query:
/*-AGEING AND BLOCKED AND PARKED INVOICES
https://globe7ams.nestle.com:26001/irj/servlet/prt/portal/prtroot/pcd!3aportal_content!2fevery_user!2fgeneral!2fdefaultFLPFrameworkContent!2fcom.sap.portal.standalonecontentarea?NavigationTarget=navurl://3ff478ce357e9ff651f65b5707604154&DrillDownLevel=0&ExecuteLocally=true&NavMode=1&sapDocumentRenderingMode=Edge&windowId=WIDx1736955960971&fromFFP=true&noIEModeReentrant=true
*/
WITH PARK AS (
SELECT 
WEEK(PARK.BUDAT) WEEK_NUMBER
,PARK.BUKRS COMPANY_CODE
,(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)), bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)) >= 0 THEN '1: Days until due'
      WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)), bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)) <0 
      AND DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)), bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0))  >=-7 THEN '2: 1-7 Days past due'
      WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)),bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)) < -7
      AND DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)), bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0))  >=-14 THEN '3: 8-14 Days past due'
      WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)),bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)) < -14
      AND DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)), bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0))  >=-30 THEN '4: 15-30 Days past due'
      WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)),bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)) < -30
      AND DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)), bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0))  >=-60 THEN '5: 31-60 Days past due'
      ELSE '6: 61+ Days past due'
END) GroupingPastDue
,DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day,coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0)),bldat)) Till_Past
,DATEDIFF(day,CPUDT,CURRENT_DATE()) Blocked_Parked_Days

--,--LEFT(BLART,1) 
,'P' Paymen_Block

,rseg.SPGRP  BLOCKINGREASON_PRICE
,rseg.SPGRM BLOCKINGREASON_QTY
,rseg.SPGRT  BLOCKINGREASON_DATE
,rseg.SPGRG  BLOCKINGREASON_OPQ
,rseg.SPGRS  BLOCKINGREASON_ITEM_AMOUNT
,rseg.SPGRC  BLOCKINGREASON_QUALITY


,'0.00' Discount_Amount
,rseg.wrbtr Amount
,PARK.WAERS AS "Currency"
,PARK.dmbtr Amount_LC
,PARK.HWAER AS Local_Currency
,'' Discount_Date 
,rseg.belnr Document_Number
,CAST(rseg.buzei AS INT) Invoice_Item
,PARK.LIFNR Supplier 
,LFA1.name1 Vendor_Name
,ekko.ekgrp Purchasing_Group
,ekko.ernam Created_By 
,RSEG.WERKS Plant 
,PARK.BLDAT Document_Date
,PARK.CPUDT Entry_Date
,PARK.XBLNR Reference
,ekko.ebeln Purchasing_Document
,rseg.ebelp Item 
,unsez Our_Refrence
,'' Requisitioner
,eket.eindt Delivery_Date
,PARK.ZTERM Terms_Payment
,PARK.GJAHR Fiscal_Year
,PARK.BUDAT Posting_Date
,coalesce(coalesce(PARK.zbd1t,0),coalesce(PARK.zbd2t,0))Payment_Days

FROM EDW.PRSFC.S6_FCL_AMS_ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE_PARKED_DOCUMENTS_V PARK 
JOIN EDW.PRSFC.S6_ERPAMS_RSEG_V rseg ON LEFT(PARK.AWKEY,10) = RSEG.BELNR
LEFT JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."ERPAMS_EKKO_V" EKKO ON EKKO.EBELN = rseg.EBELN
LEFT JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."ERPAMS_EKET_V" EKET ON EKKO.EBELN = EKET.EBELN AND rseg.EBELP =EKET.EBELP
LEFT JOIN "EDW"."PRS"."S6_ERPAMS_LFA1_V" LFA1 ON LFA1.lifnr = PARK.lifnr  AND LFA1.SPRAS = 'E'
WHERE PARK.BUKRS IN('US16','US8X')
AND RSEG.WERKS IN ('5363','5873','5886','5023','5790','5791','5796','5893','5767','5743','5930',
'UM12','UM18','UM19','UM22','UM23','UM24','UM25','UM26','UM27','UM29','UM35','UM37','UM38','UM39','UM36','UM40','UM41','UM43','UM50','UM66')
AND PARK.gjahr in (2024,2025)
--AND bsart = 'Z008'
--AND PARK.BSTAT <> 'V'


--AND LEFT(PARK.AWKEY,10) IN(
--'5391120456',
--'5391120458',
--'5379798196',
--)
),
BLOCK as (

SELECT 
 week(to_date(concat(LEFT(BLOCKED.budat,4),'-',right(left(BLOCKED.budat,6),2),'-',right(BLOCKED.budat,2)),'yyyy-mm-dd')) WEEK_NUMBER
,BLOCKED.bukrs COMPANY_CODE


,(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)), bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)) >= 0 THEN '1: Days until due'
      WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)), bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)) < 0 
      AND DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)), bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0))  >=-7 THEN '2: 1-7 Days past due'
      WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)),bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)) < -7
      AND DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)), bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0))  >=-14 THEN '3: 8-14 Days past due'
      WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)),bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)) < -14
      AND DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)), bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0))  >=-30 THEN '4: 15-30 Days past due'
      WHEN DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)),bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)) < -30
      AND DATEDIFF(day, DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),DATEADD(day, coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0)), bldat))+coalesce(coalesce(bs.zbd1t,0),coalesce(bs.zbd2t,0))  >=-60 THEN '5: 31-60 Days past due'
      ELSE '6: 61+ Days past due'
END) GroupingPastDue


--,'' GroupingPastDue

,DATEDIFF(DAY,DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE()),to_date(concat(LEFT(BLOCKED.FAELL,4),'-',right(left(BLOCKED.FAELL,6),2),'-',right(BLOCKED.FAELL,2)),'yyyy-mm-dd'))Till_Past
,DATEDIFF(day,to_date(concat(LEFT(BLOCKED.budat,4),'-',right(left(BLOCKED.budat,6),2),'-',right(BLOCKED.budat,2)),'yyyy-mm-dd'),CURRENT_DATE()) -1 Blocked_Parked_Days

,EKET.ESTKZ Payment_Block

,rseg.SPGRP  BLOCKINGREASON_PRICE
,rseg.SPGRM BLOCKINGREASON_QTY
,rseg.SPGRT  BLOCKINGREASON_DATE
,rseg.SPGRG BLOCKINGREASON_OPQ
,rseg.SPGRS  BLOCKINGREASON_ITEM_AMOUNT
,rseg.SPGRC BLOCKINGREASON_QUALITY

,'0.00' Discount_Amount
,rseg.wrbtr Amount
,'USD' AS "Currency"
,rseg.wrbtr Amount_LC
,'USD' AS Local_Currency
,'' Discount_Date 
,rseg.belnr Document_Number
,CAST(rseg.buzei AS INT) Invoice_Item
,BLOCKED.LIFNR Supplier 
,LFA1.name1 Vendor_Name
,ekko.ekgrp Purchasing_Group
,ekko.ernam Created_By 
,RSEG.WERKS Plant 

,to_date(concat(LEFT(b.BLDAT,4),'-',right(left(b.BLDAT,6),2),'-',right(b.BLDAT,2)),'yyyy-mm-dd') Document_Date  
,to_date(concat(LEFT(b.CPUDT,4),'-',right(left(b.CPUDT,6),2),'-',right(b.CPUDT,2)),'yyyy-mm-dd') Entry_Date
,b.XBLNR Reference
,ekko.ebeln Purchasing_Document
,rseg.ebelp Item 
,unsez Our_Refrence
,'' Requisitioner
,eket.eindt Delivery_Date
,bs.ZTERM Terms_Payment
,BLOCKED.GJAHR Fiscal_Year
,to_date(concat(LEFT(BLOCKED.budat,4),'-',right(left(BLOCKED.budat,6),2),'-',right(BLOCKED.budat,2)),'yyyy-mm-dd') Posting_Date
,0 Payment_Days


FROM EDW.PRSCS.S6_SC_CS_ERPAMS_RBKP_BLOCKED_V BLOCKED

  MOV.SOURCE_ORGANIZATION_CODE "Source Org",

  MOV.SOURCE_VENDOR_SITE_CODE "Source Supplier Site"
FROM apps.MSC_ORDERS_V MOV,
APPS.XX_EXCEPTION_ITEMS XEI
WHERE MOV.plan_id         = 29
AND ((MOV.order_type NOT IN ( 18, 6, 7, 30, 31))
OR (MOV.order_type       IN (18, 6, 7, 30)
AND MOV.quantity_rate    <> 0)
OR (MOV.order_type        = 30
AND (MOV.fill_kill_flag   = 1
OR MOV.so_line_split      =1))
OR (MOV.order_type        = 31
AND MOV.quantity         <> 0))
AND MOV.category_set_id   = 15

DELETE D FROM [dr].[GOL_NPG_Revenue] D
  JOIN
	(SELECT DISTINCT
						 [PERIOD_NAME]
						,[PERIOD_NUMBER]
						, MC.MaxCreation
	  FROM 
						[dr].[GOL_NPG_Revenue] R
	  JOIN
			(	SELECT 
						MAX([Creation_Date]) MaxCreation 
				FROM	
						[dr].[GOL_NPG_Revenue] 
				WHERE 
						CONVERT(DATE,[Creation_Date])=CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())
			) MC ON MC.[MaxCreation]=R.[Creation_Date]
	) I
  ON D.[PERIOD_NAME]=I.[PERIOD_NAME]
  and D.[PERIOD_NUMBER]=I.[PERIOD_NUMBER]
  and D.[Creation_Date]<>I.[MaxCreation]

scripts.text:
WITH MultipleLoads AS (
						SELECT  
								 [Creation_Date]
								,[INVOICE_PERIOD]
								,RANK () OVER(PARTITION BY [INVOICE_PERIOD] ORDER BY [Creation_Date] DESC) AS RN
						FROM 
								[dr].[GOL_SKU_Revenue]
						GROUP BY 
								[Creation_Date],[INVOICE_PERIOD]
						)

DELETE 
		GOL 
FROM 
		[dr].[GOL_SKU_Revenue] GOL
JOIN 
		MultipleLoads M ON M.[Creation_Date]=GOL.[Creation_Date] AND M.[INVOICE_PERIOD]=GOL.[INVOICE_PERIOD]
WHERE 
		M.RN>1

DELETE D FROM [dr].[GOL_NPG_Account_Budget] D
  JOIN
	(SELECT DISTINCT
						 [PERIOD_NAME]

				WHERE

	) I

-- Insert data from source table to target table
INSERT INTO [dr].[SF_S6_SC_OTR_AMS_DeliveryData_DM] ( [SalesDocument],[SalesDocumentItemNumber],[SalesOrganization],[DeliveryType],
    [Delivery],[DeliveryItem],[DeliveryCreatedOn],[DeliveryCreatedAt],[DeliveryHeaderPlannedGoodsMovementDate],
    [DeliveryChangedOn],[MeansOfTransportID],[ActualGoodsMovementDate], [MeansofTransport],[ProofOfDeliveryDate],
    [ConfirmationTime],[SequentialLegalDeliveryNumber],[DeliveryItemCategory],[StorageLocation],[LogisticalGroup],
    [DeliveryQuantitySalesUnit],[DocumentCategoryOfSubsequentDocument],[ActualQuantityDeliveredInStockkeepingUnits],  
    [ActualQuantityDeliveredInSalesUnits], [WorldwideUniqueKeyForDeliveryNumberAndDeliveryItem], [LastTimeStamp],
    [TotalGoodsMovementStatus],[BillingStatus],[DeliveryOverallProcessingStatusOfDocument],[DeliveryProofOfDeliveryStatusOnHeaderLevel],
    [LoadNumber],[LoadItem],[LoadStatus],[RouteDropNumber],[DeliveryQuantityChangeReason],[DeliveryQuantityChangeReasonDescription],
    [MODIFIEDBY],[MODIFIEDDATE])
SELECT  [SalesDocument],[SalesDocumentItemNumber],[SalesOrganization],[DeliveryType],
    [Delivery],[DeliveryItem],[DeliveryCreatedOn],[DeliveryCreatedAt],[DeliveryHeaderPlannedGoodsMovementDate],
    [DeliveryChangedOn],[MeansOfTransportID],[ActualGoodsMovementDate], [MeansofTransport],[ProofOfDeliveryDate],
    [ConfirmationTime],[SequentialLegalDeliveryNumber],[DeliveryItemCategory],[StorageLocation],[LogisticalGroup],
    [DeliveryQuantitySalesUnit],[DocumentCategoryOfSubsequentDocument],[ActualQuantityDeliveredInStockkeepingUnits],  
    [ActualQuantityDeliveredInSalesUnits], [WorldwideUniqueKeyForDeliveryNumberAndDeliveryItem], 
    TRY_CAST(STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(CAST([LastTimeStamp] AS VARCHAR(14)), 13, 0, ':'), 11, 0, ':'), 9, 0, ' ') AS DATETIME) AS [LastTimeStamp],
    [TotalGoodsMovementStatus],[BillingStatus],[DeliveryOverallProcessingStatusOfDocument],[DeliveryProofOfDeliveryStatusOnHeaderLevel],
    [LoadNumber],[LoadItem],[LoadStatus],[RouteDropNumber],[DeliveryQuantityChangeReason],[DeliveryQuantityChangeReasonDescription],
     SYSTEM_USER AS MODIFIEDBY, GETDATE() AS MODIFIEDDATE
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY SalesDocument, [SalesDocumentItemNumber], SalesOrganization, LastTimeStamp
               ORDER BY LastTimeStamp DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM [dr].[OTR_DeliveryData]
    WHERE DeliveryCreatedOn >= '2024-01-01'
) AS Ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

max(od.DistributionChannel) as DistributionChannel,  
max(od.IncotermsPart1) as IncotermsPart1,  
max(od.OrdPlannedGIDate) as OrderPlannedGoodsIssueDate,

max(dd.Delivery) as Delivery,
max(dd.LoadNumber) as LoadNumber,
max(dd.LogisticalGroup) as LogisticalGroup,
max(od.SDItemGroupingIndicator) as ItemGroupingIndicator,
max(inc.BillingDocument) as BillingDocument,
'N' as HasOrderException,
max(inc.InvoiceStatus) as InvoiceStatus,
max(od.CustHierLevel6) as CustomerHierarchyLevel6,
max(od.CustHierLevel4) as CustomerHierarchyLevel4,
max(od.[Plant(OwnOrExternal)]) as Plant,
max(od.OrderAppointmentFromTimeAM) as OrderAppointmentFromTimeAM,
convert(float,max(NetValueOfTheSalesOrderInDocumentCurrency)) as NetValueOfTheSalesOrderInDocumentCurrency,
max(dd.BillingStatus) as BillingStatus,
max(dd.ProofOfDeliveryDate) as ProofOfDeliveryDate ,
max(od.SalesDocumentItemCategory) as SalesDocumentItemCategory,
max(od.BillingBlockInSDDocument) as BillingBlockInSalesDocument,
max(od.DeliveryBlock) as DeliveryBlock,
max(od.StandardCarrierAccessCode) as StandardCarrierAccessCode,  
max(od.VendorName1) as VendorName,  
max(od.VendorNumber) as VendorNumber,
max(od.[SalesDocumentItem(POSNR)]) as SalesDocumentItemNumber,
max(od.Route) as Route,
max(od.NetValueOfTheOrderItemInDocumentCurrency) as NetValueOfTheOrderItemInDocumentCurrency,
max(ms.ObjectKey) as ObjectKey,max(InitialLoadPlanProcessingTimestamp) as InitialLoadPlanProcessingTimestamp,
max(concat(od.SalesOrganization,od.DistributionChannel)) as SalesArea,
max(case when dd.LoadNumber is not null then dd.LoadNumber
when od.SDItemGroupingIndicator is not null and len(od.SDItemGroupingIndicator)=10 and trim(od.SDItemGroupingIndicator)!='' then od.SDItemGroupingIndicator
when dd.LogisticalGroup is not null and len(dd.LogisticalGroup)=10 and trim(dd.LogisticalGroup)!='' then dd.LogisticalGroup end) as LoadNumberOfficial
from
(select distinct SalesDocument from  dt.OrderStatusTracking_DeltaLog ) DL  --ONLY SALES DOC   --to aviod many to many 
 
 inner  join (select * from [dr].[SF_S6_SC_OTR_AMS_ORDERDATA_DM] od1
  where od1.SalesOrganization in ('US01','US02','US03','US04','US05','US06','US07','US08', 'US8R','US8O')
and od1.SalesDocumentType IN ( 'TA', 'ZSAD', 'ZDON', 'ZALV', 'ZTSA', 'ZOBC','ZIMS')
) od
on (od.SalesDocument = DL.SalesDocument )-- and od.[SalesDocumentItem(POSNR)]= DL.[SalesDocumentItem]) REMOVED TO MAKE SALESdOC Unique

 
left join (select SalesDocument,[SalesDocumentItem(POSNR)], max(hasOrderExcep) as hasOrderExcep from  [dr].[SF_S6_SC_OTR_AMS_ORDEROTHERDATA_DM]
group by  SalesDocument,[SalesDocumentItem(POSNR)]) odotr on
od.SalesDocument = odotr.SalesDocument and od.[SalesDocumentItem(POSNR)]= odotr.[SalesDocumentItem(POSNR)]
 
left outer join [dr].[SF_S6_SC_OTR_AMS_DeliveryData_DM]  dd
on dd.SalesDocument=od.SalesDocument and dd.SalesDocumentItemNumber = od.[SalesDocumentItem(POSNR)]
 
left outer join (select ObjectKey,max(convert(DateTime,(concat(cast(ProcessingDate as Date),' ',ProcessingTime)),102)) as InitialLoadPlanProcessingTimestamp
from dr.SF_S6_SC_CS_ERPAMS_MESSAGESTATUS_DM
where MessageType='TRS0' and ProcessingStatusOfMessage='1' group by ObjectKey) as ms
on ms.ObjectKey=od.SalesDocument
 
left outer join (select max(BillingDocument) as BillingDocument, max(SalesDocument) as incSalesDocument,max(StatusForTransferToAccounting) as InvoiceStatus
from  dr.SF_S6_SC_OTR_AMS_INVOICEDATA_DM
group by BillingDocument) as inc
on inc.incSalesDocument=od.SalesDocument where
concat(od.SalesOrganization,od.DistributionChannel)!='US0313' and concat(od.SalesOrganization,od.DistributionChannel)!='US0607'
and od.DistributionChannel!='13' and (od.ReasonForRejectionOfQuotationsAndSalesOrders is null or len(od.ReasonForRejectionOfQuotationsAndSalesOrders)=1 or od.ReasonForRejectionOfQuotationsAndSalesOrders='')
and od.SalesDocumentType!='ZRF' and od.SalesDocumentType!='RE'
and SalesDocumentItemCategory!='ZTIB' and SalesDocumentItemCategory!='ZTOB' and  SalesDocumentItemCategory!='ZATX' and SalesDocumentItemCategory!='TAXT'
and (inc.InvoiceStatus != 'C' or inc.InvoiceStatus is null or (inc.InvoiceStatus = 'C' and od.SalesDocumentCreatedOn > dateadd(year, -1, getdate())))
group by od.SalesDocument

WITH orderstatusChangeLogcd1 (CommercialGroupingIndicator, ChangeDescription, OldValue, NewValue, CreationDate, TimeChanged, IsDeleted, LastTimeStamp,OverallExecutionStatus, UpdatedDateTime)
AS
(
select n.CommercialGroupingIndicator,s.ChangeDescription,s.OldValue,s.NewValue,s.CreationDate,s.TimeChanged,s.IsDeleted,
s.LastTimeStamp,n.OverallExecutionStatus,
try_convert(DateTime,concat(s.CreationDate,' ',s.TimeChanged)) as UpdatedDateTime
from [dr].[S6_SC_TM_ROOTNODE_DM] n
inner join [dr].S6_SC_TM_ENHANCEDCHANGELOGFORTOR s
on n.DBKey=s.ParentKey
where (s.ChangeDescription like 'APPOINTMENT DATE/TIME CHANGED%' or s.ChangeDescription like 'LIFECYCLE STATUS CHANGED%')
),
orderstatusChangeLogcd2 (CommercialGroupingIndicator, ChangeDescription, OldValue, NewValue, CreationDate, TimeChanged, IsDeleted, LastTimeStamp,OverallExecutionStatus, UpdatedDateTime)
AS
(
select CommercialGroupingIndicator,ChangeDescription,OldValue,NewValue,CreationDate,TimeChanged,IsDeleted,
LastTimeStamp,OverallExecutionStatus,UpdatedDateTime
from orderstatusChangeLogcd1
where (ChangeDescription like '%DIRECTION : O' or ChangeDescription like '%LIFECYCLE STATUS CHANGED')
and NewValue!='10'
),
RelevantValues1 (CommercialGroupingIndicator,ChangeDescription, UpdatedDateTime,OverallExecutionStatus)
AS
(
select CommercialGroupingIndicator,ChangeDescription, max(UpdatedDateTime) AS UpdatedDateTime,max(OverallExecutionStatus) as OverallExecutionStatus
from orderstatusChangeLogcd2    
group by CommercialGroupingIndicator, ChangeDescription
),
RelevantValues2 (CommercialGroupingIndicator, UpdatedDateTime,OverallExecutionStatus)
AS
(
select CommercialGroupingIndicator, max(UpdatedDateTime) AS UpdatedDateTime,max(OverallExecutionStatus) as OverallExecutionStatus
from RelevantValues1
group by CommercialGroupingIndicator
)
SELECT distinct os.CommercialGroupingIndicator, os.ChangeDescription, OldValue, NewValue, CreationDate, TimeChanged, IsDeleted, LastTimeStamp,rv.OverallExecutionStatus, os.UpdatedDateTime
FROM orderstatusChangeLogcd2 os
INNER JOIN RelevantValues2 rv
ON os.CommercialGroupingIndicator = rv.CommercialGroupingIndicator
AND os.UpdatedDateTime = rv.UpdatedDateTime

ALTER DATABASE [@{variables('v_database')}]
MODIFY (SERVICE_OBJECTIVE = '@{pipeline().parameters.p_dwsize}');

WHILE
(
    SELECT TOP 1 state_desc
    FROM sys.dm_operation_status
    WHERE
        1=1
        AND resource_type_desc = 'Database'
        AND major_resource_id = '@{variables('v_database')}'
        AND operation = 'ALTER DATABASE'
    ORDER BY
        start_time DESC
) = 'IN_PROGRESS'
BEGIN
    RAISERROR('Scale operation in progress',0,0) WITH NOWAIT;
    WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:05';
END
PRINT 'Complete';

        AND WP02."YTMEPOGID" LIKE ('US8%')

        --WP11."YTM_CONTY",
        --WP11."YTMDLOTYP" ,  
        --WP11."YTMDELVMD"
