truncate table [dr].[F_Redeployment_StockTransferOrders];

insert into [dr].[F_Redeployment_StockTransferOrders]
SELECT EKPO.EBELN  as 
PurchaseOrderNumber,right(EKPO.MATNR,8) as MaterialID,
EKET.MENGE as Quantity,
cast(EINDT as datetime) AS ReceiptDate,
cast(WADAT as datetime) as ShippingDate,
EKPO.WERKS as DestinationLocationID,
(case when ISNULL(EKKO.RESWK,'')='' then EKKO.LIFNR ELSE
EKKO.RESWK END) as OriginLocationID,
(case when ISNULL(EKKO.RESWK,'')='' then  '2'
WHEN ISNULL(EKKO.RESWK,'')<> '' and cast(WADAT as date) <getdate() then '3'
else '1' end) OrderStatusID,
(case when ISNULL(EKKO.RESWK,'')='' then  'PO INBOUND'
WHEN ISNULL(EKKO.RESWK,'')<> '' and cast(WADAT as date) is not null
and cast(WADAT as date) <cast(getdate() as date) then 'SHIPPED, NOT RECEIVED'
else 'ON HAND NOT SHIPPED' end) OrderStatusDescription,
cast(getdate() as datetime) as ModifiedDate,
'nhscsqladmin' as ModifiedBy,
cast(getdate() as datetime) as SnapshotDate,
'Y' as ActiveFlag,
cast(EKKO.AEDAT as date) as STOCreationDate,
EKPO.EBELP as PurchaseOrderLine,
EKPO.LABNR as DeliveryNote,
'ASN-'+EKPO.LABNR AS ShipmentID,
EKKO.GLB_GRP_IND AS FreightOrderID
FROM [dr].[NHSC_3PL_Inbound_EKET] EKET,
dr.[NHSC_3PL_Inbound_EKPO] EKPO,
[dr].[NHSC_3PL_Inbound_EKKO] EKKO
WHERE  EKET.EBELN = EKPO.EBELN
AND EKET.EBELP = EKPO.EBELP
and EKPO.EBELN=EKKO.EBELN
AND ISNULL(EKPO.LOEKZ,'N') <>'L'
--AND ISNULL(EKPO.ELIKZ,'N') <> 'X'
and ISNULL(EKPO.IS_DELETED,'N')='N'
and ISNULL(EKET.IS_DELETED,'N')='N'
and ISNULL(EKKO.IS_DELETED,'N')='N'
and EKPO.MTART in ('FERT','HALB')
--and cast(EINDT as date)<cast(getdate() as date)
and cast(EINDT as date)>=cast(getdate()-365 as date) ;

  EDW.PRS.MDH_T179_V AS tt
  INNER JOIN EDW.PRSCS.S6_SC_CS_MDH_MVKE_V AS dm ON dm.PRODH = tt.PRODH
  LEFT JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_T179_V AS tt_l2 ON LEFT (dm.PRODH, 2) = tt_l2.PRODH
  LEFT JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_T179_V AS tt_l3 ON LEFT (dm.PRODH, 3) = tt_l3.PRODH
  LEFT JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_T179_V AS tt_l5 ON LEFT (dm.PRODH, 5) = tt_l5.PRODH
  LEFT JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_T179_V AS tt_l9 ON LEFT (dm.PRODH, 9) = tt_l9.PRODH
 -- LEFT JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_MARA_V m on dm.matnr = m.matnr
 -- LEFT JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_BRAND_HIER_VW br on br."CorporateBrandCode" = m.yycbr and br."RangeBrandCode" = m.yyrbr and br."BrandDenominationCode" = m.yydbr
  
WHERE
  dm.VKORG IN ('US8R', 'US8O')
  AND LENGTH (dm.PRODH) = 15
  --AND RIGHT (dm.MATNR, 8) IN ('12502336')
  AND dm.refresh_date = (
    SELECT
      MAX(dmx.refresh_date)
    FROM
      EDW.PRS.MDH_T179_V AS ttx
      INNER JOIN EDW.PRSCS.S6_SC_CS_MDH_MVKE_V AS dmx ON dmx.PRODH = ttx.PRODH
    WHERE
      dmx.VKORG IN ('US8R', 'US8O')
      AND LENGTH (dmx.PRODH) = 15
      AND dmx.MATNR = dm.matnr
  )
ORDER BY
  dm.MATNR

SELECT
  DISTINCT dm.MATNR AS MATERIAL_NUMBER,
  dm.PRODH AS PRODH,
  LEFT (dm.PRODH, 2) AS L1_Business,
  tt_l2.vtext L1_Business_Desc,
  LEFT (dm.PRODH, 3) AS L2_Business_ID,
  tt_l3.vtext L2_Business_ID_Desc,
  LEFT (dm.PRODH, 5) AS L3_Category,
   tt_l5.vtext L3_Category_Desc,
  LEFT (dm.PRODH, 9) AS L4_Sub_Category,
   tt_l9.vtext L4_Sub_Category_Desc,   
  LEFT (dm.PRODH, 15) AS L5_Segment,  
  tt.VTEXT AS L5_Segment_DESCRIPTION,
  dm.LAST_TIMESTAMP AS TIMESTAMP
 -- br."CorporateBrandCode",
 -- br."MarketingCorporateBrand",
  --br."RangeBrandCode",
  --br."MarketingMasterBrand",
  --br."BrandDenominationCode",
  --br."MarketingDenominationBrand"   
FROM
  EDW.PRS.MDH_T179_V AS tt
  INNER JOIN EDW.PRSCS.S6_SC_CS_MDH_MVKE_V AS dm ON dm.PRODH = tt.PRODH
  LEFT JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_T179_V AS tt_l2 ON LEFT (dm.PRODH, 2) = tt_l2.PRODH
  LEFT JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_T179_V AS tt_l3 ON LEFT (dm.PRODH, 3) = tt_l3.PRODH
  LEFT JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_T179_V AS tt_l5 ON LEFT (dm.PRODH, 5) = tt_l5.PRODH
  LEFT JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_T179_V AS tt_l9 ON LEFT (dm.PRODH, 9) = tt_l9.PRODH
 -- LEFT JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_MARA_V m on dm.matnr = m.matnr
 -- LEFT JOIN EDW.PRS.MDH_BRAND_HIER_VW br on br."CorporateBrandCode" = m.yycbr and br."RangeBrandCode" = m.yyrbr and br."BrandDenominationCode" = m.yydbr
  
WHERE LEFT(dm.PRODH, 3) IN ('USA', 'USZ', 'US7', 'USM', 'US8', 'US1', 'US4', 'US0')
  --dm.VKORG IN ('US8R', 'US8O')
  AND LENGTH (dm.PRODH) = 15
  --AND RIGHT (dm.MATNR, 8) IN ('12502336')
  AND dm.refresh_date = (
    SELECT
      MAX(dmx.refresh_date)
    FROM
      EDW.PRS.MDH_T179_V AS ttx
      INNER JOIN EDW.PRSCS.S6_SC_CS_MDH_MVKE_V AS dmx ON dmx.PRODH = ttx.PRODH
    WHERE LEFT(dmx.PRODH, 3) IN ('USA', 'USZ', 'US7', 'USM', 'US8', 'US1', 'US4', 'US0')
      --dmx.VKORG IN ('US8R', 'US8O')
      AND LENGTH (dmx.PRODH) = 15
      AND dmx.MATNR = dm.matnr
  )
ORDER BY
  dm.MATNR

declare @monthrange_begin date = '@{pipeline().parameters.Window_Start_Date}'
declare @monthrange_end date = '@{if(empty(pipeline().parameters.Window_End_Date),formatDateTime(utcnow(),'yyyy-MM-dd'),pipeline().parameters.Window_End_Date)}'
declare @totalmonths int= datediff(month,@monthrange_begin,@monthrange_end)+1
declare @monthsinbatch int = @{pipeline().parameters.monthsInBatch}
declare @cw int = 0
declare @begindate date
declare @enddate date
declare @monthfilter varchar(2000) = ''
declare @currentdate datetime = @monthrange_begin
while @cw < @totalmonths
begin
set @begindate=DATEADD(month,@cw,@currentdate)
set @enddate= case when @cw+@monthsinbatch-1 >= @totalmonths then DATEADD(month,@totalmonths-1,@currentdate) else  DATEADD(month,@cw+@monthsinbatch-1,@currentdate) end

set @monthfilter +=  CONCAT('|''' ,format(DATEADD(day, -DAY(@begindate)+1,@begindate),'yyyy-MM-dd')
                                 ,''':'''
                                 ,format(EOMONTH(@enddate),'yyyy-MM-dd'),'''')
set @cw = @cw+@monthsinbatch
end
set @monthfilter = stuff(@monthfilter,1,1,'')
SELECT Substring(value,2,10) as Window_Start_Date, Substring(value,15,10) as Window_End_Date
    FROM STRING_SPLIT(@monthfilter, '|')

WITH LIST_PARTY AS(

SELECT DISTINCT
			COALESCE([Party_Name],[Party_Number]) AS [Party_Name],
			COALESCE([Party_Number],[Party_Name]) AS Party_Number,
			Retail_Partner_Level,
			ISNULL(GL_Account_Division,'999') AS Division,
			ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY [Party_Number],ISNULL(GL_Account_Division,'999') ORDER BY CASE WHEN [Notes]='Data from System' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC) RN
		
FROM
			[dr].[GOL_SOLGAR_MC_DATA]
			)

INSERT INTO [dr].[DIM_GOL_Party]

SELECT 
		Party_Name,
		Party_Number,
		Division,
		Retail_Partner_Level 
FROM LIST_PARTY L
WHERE RN=1 AND NOT EXISTS (
												SELECT 1
												FROM [dr].[DIM_GOL_Party] D
												WHERE	D.[PARTY_NUMBER] = L.Party_Number
														AND D.Division=L.Division
												)
